docs.title: Themes and Vibes
docs.text:
Pulp adventure refers to stories, films, and games featuring high-octane, action-packed narratives set in exotic locales, with a focus on rugged heroes battling villains and seeking lost artifacts.

Key Characteristics

  • Exotic settings
  • Rugged heroes
  • Lost artifacts and ancient secrets
  • High-stakes action
  • Villains and danger
  • Fast-paced & dramatic

Noir intrigue refers to the complex, shadowy plots and mysterious, often morally ambiguous situations found in the film noir genre, characterized by themes of betrayal, crime, and existential dread

Key Characteristics

  • Complex plots
  • Moral ambiguity

Media Touchstones Media touchstones: Casablanca, From Hell, The Maltese Falcon, The Mummy, Pirates of the Caribbean, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Fifth Element, Inglourious Basterds, etc.

docs.title: House Rules
docs.text:
• Changes - Players can retract or change things their characters did up until the point they learn the consequences of their actions. Once I describe what happens as a result, it’s too late for the players to change their minds.
  • Dice Rolling - Players must roll their dice in view of everyone, unless directed by the DM otherwise. Any dice that rolls off the table or is cocked needs to be rerolled.
  • Flanking - When a player or creature is flanked, meaning having an opponent on both sides of them within 5ft, the flankers receive advantage on attack rolls.
  • Critical Hits - We use the Max + Roll variant for Critical Hits. Meaning that if your normal weapong damage would be 1d6 + 3, on a Crit you would deal 6 + d6 + 3.

docs.title: Rooftop Rendezvous
docs.text:
Sergeant Germaine Vilroy, of the Sharn City Watch, is waiting at the top of Lyrandar Tower, Upper Central District for her contacts to arrive so she can give them their mission. Cassian ir'Bellona, S.A.M., and Caelin arrive via airship. Moments later the two Sharn locals, Renée and Cligs, arrive via skycoach. They each introduce themselves and Vilroy gives them the following information:

  • A warforged named Coal had reached out to report a crime being committed in Old Sharn.
  • She wants the party to meet with Coal first and see if what she says adds up. She is worried that, with her status as a Watch sergeant, her presence will call undue attention and endanger Coal.
  • She offers them 25gp upfront and another 25gp for completing the mission
  • She setup a meeting place at the Cog Carnival in High Walls, Lower Tavick's Landing
  • She has set them up in an inn in Middle Dura, called Gallanda Hall
  • She has provided a writ of enforcement to the group to show that they are on official business

Upon further pressing her for information, she also reveals:

  • That she is on the take from the Boromar Clan and they are interested in what is happening in Old Sharn
  • She is trying to avoid getting the City Watch in the middle of a conflict between Daask and Boromar

docs.title: Why us?
docs.text:
The group sets out to the inn to prepare for their meeting with Coal and checkout their accommodations. On the way they each talk about their connection to the Sergeant and why they may have been called upon for this task. They seem suspicious that this group was put together for such a task.

Before heading out to meet with Coal they make a stop to do some shopping. Each member purchases a Feather Token.

Feather Token

Wonderous item, common

This small metal disk is inscribed with the image of a feather. When you fall at least 20 feet while the token is on your person, you descend 60 feet per round and take no damage from falling. The token's magic is expended after you land, whereupon the disk becomes nonmagical.

docs.title: A bar, a chase, and a massacre
docs.text:
The group travels to High Walls, a district in Lower Tavick's Landing that is completely surrounded by walls and fortified Sharn City Watch checkpoints are at each bridge crossing. The district is home primarily to refugees of the Last War, primarily former warforged soldiers and Cyrans. It is run down and many of the buildings are falling apart. They find their way to the Cog Carnival and to Coal, who is sitting alone at the bar, mostly through bribes.

Initially on edge by the groups approach, Coal begins to calm down when they produce Vilroy's writ of enforcement. She begins to tell the group about the Daask excavation site, the kidnapping of Caden d'Orien, and the murder of her friend Razor. At that moment, an explosion hits the wall just behind Coal's head, assuming that the group has set her up she makes a break for it and a chase ensues.

The group takes off after her, with some pausing to take in the scene and try to figure out who the assailant was. Renée is able to identify that the attacker was a kobold. During the chase, Renée and Cligs keep after the kobold while Cassian, Caelin, and S.A.M. continue after Coal. Renée is eventually able to catch the kobold, with assistance from Clig's message. Likewise, Caelin is able to convince Coal via message to stop running and let them help her.

Renée and Cligs interrogate the kobold, Jerry for information. He informs them that his group received a letter from a higher up in Daask with instructions on where and when to find Coal and to eliminate her. He claims not to know anything else. Cligs also liberates Jerry of his Wand of Firebolt.

Wand of Firebolt

Wand, uncommon (requires attunement by a spellcaster)

This wand has 3 charges. While holding it, you can expend 1 charge to cast Firebolt from it.

Regaining Charges The wand regains 1 expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the wand's last charge, roll 1d20). On a 1, the wand crumbles into ashes and is destroyed.

Separately, Cassian, Caelin, and S.A.M. catch up and start to talk with Coal. They don't get to talk to her long before the rest of Jerry's hit squad shows up: 3 more kobolds and a shifter named Hound. Combat ensues and S.A.M. quickly dispatches the 3 kobolds with a close range thunderwave. Hound is also quickly eliminated by the trio, with Coal's help.

Renée, Cligs, and Jerry catch up the rest of the group. Jerry, seeing the eviscerated remains of his friends, shares that he doesn't know anything about the excavation site or what is happening there or anything about the child. He tells them that the message was sent to the Whispering Hag Tavern a popular Daask hangout in the Malleon's Gate district of Lower Dura. That the order came from Garra and that Hound has this note in his pocket. Cligs give Coal the decision about Jerry's fate and she quickly dispatches him. She also shares with the group:

  • Razor served with Coal in the Cyran military during the Last War, during which Coal lost her right arm.
  • Razor and Coal had trouble finding work in Sharn, due to the fact that many businesses are reluctant to hire warforged foreigners. The pair became desperate for money.
  • A month ago, Razor told Coal she had a job working on a long-term secret mission for Alden d'Orien, the scion of a dragonmarked house. Warforged from other parts of the city were also recruited to help in the task. The job required physical labor, so Coal's injury prevented her from being able to do the job. Razor planned to save money then buy Coal a new arm so she could work with her.
  • Razor would often come back from work sullen or wounded but never opened up about the job until shortly before she died. Razor confessed that the job was more dangerous than it seemed when she was recruited. Razor was planning to quit before she died.
  • Coal knew that Razor had been killed or died when she didn't return several days ago.

Initially reluctant to go with the group and preferring to leave the city, she finally agrees to accompany them to their debrief with Sergeant Vilroy that evening.

docs.title: We want more money
docs.text:
The group meets up with Vilroy at the inn she set them up in. They present Coal and share all that has happened, Coal also provides her with all of the information that she shared with group. Realizing that this is much bigger than initially thought, Vilroy encourages the group to keep up the investigation and to meet with Alden d'Orien in the morning and diplomatically question him about his involvement.

The group negotiates an additional 25gp each fee for the continued investigation, along with assistance in getting Coal somewhere safe. Vilroy agrees and the group heads off to bed. Not being at all circumspect about it, Cligs invites Vilroy to her room - she accepts.

docs.title: Confronting Alden
docs.text:
The next morning, before they head out, Renée sends a message to her cousin with the information about the Daask hideout. Additionally, Caelin makes a quick stop to stock up on medicinal herbs on their way. The group heads to Mithral Tower to meet with Alden, who is at his home the Unicorn Estate. The guards are reluctant to let the group in, but they are able to convince them through the potential scandal of the information they have and the writ of enforcement.

Meeting with Alden it is clear the man has seen better days, he appears haggard and not as one would expect someone in his position. He initially tries to brush off their questions but under sustained pressure, he breaks. He reveals that his only son, Caden d'Orien, was kidnapped a month ago. Shortly thereafter he was approached by the half-ogre Garra to supply warforged workers under a House Orien cover for an excavation site in Old Sharn. He was told if he went to the Watch or didn't comply Caden would be killed. At this, he breaks down and runs into the house.

Vishtai, his kalashtar assistant, telepathically encourages the group to save Caden, indicating that House Orien would owe them a great debt for doing so. He also gives them the location and a hint at how to operate the means via which Daask is accessing the dig site.

docs.title: Going down?
docs.text: The group make their way to the elevator that Vishtai indicated, finding it occupied with two teenage lovers who demand that they leave them at once. They are eventually persuaded to leave the lift without much fuss. The group discovers the secret Medusa panel that Vishtai indicated and Cligs is able to figure out how the mechanism works and they descend into the depths of the city.

docs.title: Masacre Numero Dos
docs.text:
After the extended elevator ride, the group arrives in a massive cavern that is in almost complete darkness. Using their light sources, they are able to identify a 50ft wide, 10ft deep hole in front of them and they hear from across the gaps what sounds like soft sobs of a child.

The group splits into the stealthy and the not-so-stealthy and each make their way around the hole. The not-so group is ambushed by a quartet of Goblin about halfway around the hole. They manage to quickly turn the group in Goblin-goo and continue on their path. Cligs is able to identify that there is a group of the warforged workers being held captive in the center of the hole. The group frees them and goes to rescue Caden. Cassian is able to break the shackles holding him, and having used a crowbar is able to avoid the poison on them that was keeping Caden in his comatose state. Renée is able to rouse him with a Goodberry, she also shares some with the group.

After rescuing all of these people, they learn the following additional details:

  • Garra was the one who was keeping Caden captive and orchestrating the work
  • It seems that they had found what she was looking for, the ruins of an ancient library and she was able to take a number of books and schema from it.
  • The work being done, the warforged were ordered to close up the entrance and they were being kept here until the goods were out of the city.

docs.title: Demanding Restitution
docs.text:
The group take Caden and a representative of the warforged workers, Anvil, back up to Alden. He is overjoyed to have his son back but doesn't seem that remorseful about the plight of the warforged. He claims to have no knowledge of how they were treated or any deaths that happened. He was trying to keep his son alive. Still, he is persuaded to provide each of the remaining workerss 10gp. He also conveys the following information to the group:

  • Garra is working for someone much higher up in Daask, someone named Niho Koi
  • He knows that she has recovered what she was looking for in the excavation site and that the items are scheduled to leave Sharn for Droaam via lightning rail.
  • He gives them the address of hers in Terminus, Lower Tavick's Landing that was the storage location for the goods
  • He also offers the group a 50gp incentive to keep House Orien out of any report they make to the City Watch. The group successfully convinces him to raise it to 100gp.
  • They are also given a second Feather Token, this one in the shape of a unicorn head, inscribed with the House Orien sigil.

docs.title: Olarune 6
docs.text:
Having "escaped" from Garrow and the Emerald Claw soldiers, the group is weighing their options for reaching Whitehearth now that they have it's location. Remembering some details about traveling the Mournland from their reading, Cornelius relays to the group how dangerous it could be to travel there on foot. The group decides to wait the 19 hours until Failin returns for their meetup and than convince him to take them there in the land cart.

S.A.M. suggests hiding in the abandoned quarry for shelter. Cligs shares with the group that there is little presence of civilization out this far, so it's possible that there could be dangerous creatures or even roving bands of unfriendly goblinoids, so they should be careful and set a watch.

The group travels down one of the access ramps into the quarry and finds the first open work tunnel. They do a quick check and find the remnants of people that fled quickly and left the work that they were doing. The place otherwise seems untouched since the disaster that took out the town four years ago.

They decide to take two sets of long rests to ensure everyone is rested but that a watch is maintained. Caelin and Cornelius took up the first watch, with S.A.M. semi-resting and being on alert as well. During the watch there is a giant spider that approaches the group but Caelin is able to talk to it and convince it to go away. S.A.M. takes over towards the end of the watch and before the second watch comes on, he doesn't see anything interesting and there are no incidents. Cligs, Cassian, and SAM take the second watch and the time passes by without issue.

docs.title: One way or another, we're getting on that land cart
docs.text:
Before heading out to meet with Failin, S.A.M. tells the group if they can't convince Failin to take them into the Mournland with money than they may need to force him to take them. Some of the group seem resistant to this but ultimately it's decided that at this point this is their only option to get there before Garrow and safely.

The conversation with Failin doesn't go well at first. He is adamant that it's time to retun to Rhukaan Draal and doesn't want to continue. S.A.M. tries to convince him and ultimately tries to threaten him, but Failin believes he holds the advantage because they can't make the cart work without him. Caelin takes over the negotiation in Thieves Cant and is eventually able to convince Failin to take them, for 10 pp per rider. He also tells them that at the first sign of trouble for him or his cart, he will turn back. Cornelius offers Failin the Olladra's Chalice as a downpayment and for a potential discount. He doesn't negotiate well but Failin gives them a 1 pp discount off the deal but still charges them 9pp per person, payment upfront.

On the way there Cligs tries to apologize to Failin. SAM takes this opportunity to send messages to the others about what needs to happen when they get to Whitehearth. He is adamant that Failin can not be left alone and unsecured while they venture in or he will leave them. They need to ensure he is there to take them back. The others seem to agree.

docs.title: Bad, worse, and worst
docs.text:
After about 30 minutes of travel, they make it to the wall of mist that completely encompasses what once was the jewel of Galifar. Entering the mists they notice that sound feels muffled and distant and a feeling of isolation and dread builds in all of the non-Warforged party members. Luckily, they are on the land cart so they are able to quickly traverse the danger and make it through.

Traveling a short distance into the Mournland, they encounter swirling black mists that seem to descend from the sky and cover a large area - impossible to avoid. They make their way into the Doldrum Storm and they begin to hear hissing whispers and feel lethargic and listless. S.A.M., hearing the whispers but unaffected by it, decides to play music - a riot of noises to drown out the whispers around them. He does this until they pass through the Storm and once on the other side of it almost everyone is able to quickly shake the feeling. Cligs and Failin aren't so lucky and suffer from exhaustion as a result.

Continuing on their way, they enter an area of the Mournland that seems like the ground is constantly moving and shaking, as if a constant earthquake is happening. Luckily, again, the land cart protects them from the effects of this and they begin to pass through the region. Eventually they see masses of large worms poking out of the land, trying to probe the cart and see what is in it's land. Cornelius tosses some of his boar meat out a distance to see what happens and notices that it is quickly swallowed up by a mass of worms. As he does it and is reaching over, the mound of worms below forms into a makeshift hand and grabs him up from the cart as it's giant body, fully made of tens of thousands of worms, rises out of the ground. The group is able to free Cornelius and decides the best way to get away from this danger is to toss it the rest of the boar meat, giving it ample food to distract it as they get away.

Further down the "road" they are traveling, the come upon a curious site. They see several corpses strewn about that don't seem to be decayed at all. They also see two green bubbles floating around in what clearly seems like they are playing. At one point one of them does a dive and seems to spit out a human head, completely cleaned of flesh. Cligs studies these creatures and determines that they seem to be a living version of a Acid Splash. She also tests a theory by making an illusion close to them, which they quickly attack. They don't seem to notice the part though, and seeing what they can do the group decides it's best to leave them be.

Awhile later, the group rides into the remains of a massive battle. Like the others, they appear freshly killed, despite clearly being much older—they can easily identify Brelish and Cyran soldiers who were locked in battle. Among the sea of dead soldiers is a pile of other corpses—halflings, elves, and their mounts. While there is no smell of decay, many of the bodies are mutilated: missing limbs, heads, or sliced in half. The group decides to spend a half hour searching here and casting about with Detect Magic to see what can be found amongst the dead. They recover a number of mundane item, but also several magic ones and money. As they are returning to the land cart, they are ambushed by a giant crab that seems to be made up of dead bodies and equipment. They are able to defeat this creature and get back on the road.

Finally, they approach a series of low hills and see what looks like at first glance to be an abandoned mine shift. It's a tunnel into the hill that is framed with timbers. Upon closer inspection, they see the symbol of House Cannith emblazoned on the crossbeam - Whiteheath.

docs.title: 7 Olarune
docs.text: Having arrived at the entrance to Whitehearth, the group discusses a marching order for exploring and also assign Cornelius the task of staying with Failin and "keeping him safe." As the enter the cavern, once Cligs is the last one exposed, they hear the rustling of feathers and are ambushed by the same Zombie Vulture that they had previously seen at the Emerald Claw camp in Rose Quarry. The bird seems intent on taking out Cligs, but is no match for the group. While this was nothing more than an inconvenience, it does signal the possibility that others might be not far behind.

docs.title: One hatch, two hatch, three hatch
docs.text:
Entering the cavern, it at first seems like just an empty cave that used to be in use. They can't find any signs of recent activity. Eventually, they find a place where the cavern branches off into 3 different tunnels. Exploring the first one, they find that it dead ends but that there is a hatch embedded in the ground with a curious blue enameled recess in the center. Cligs puts the blue keycharm that they received from Elaydren into the slot and they hear a metalic click and hiss; however, when they actually open the hatch it appears to lead to solid rock. Careful examination doesn't reveal any secret mechanism or way through, so they decide to explore the other two tunnels.

One tunnel comes to an end at stone face that again they don't find any hidden mechanism at. Backtracking, the other tunnel seems to branch again and both branches have a metal hatch embedded in the floor at the end. They check the west tunnel first and inspecting the hatch find that it is trapped, it also doesn't seem to show any significant signs of wear. The other hatch, the southern one, is also trapped but they can see slight scratches in the enamel around the key hole. Cassian uses Mage Hand to insert the keycharm, pop the hatch open, and see if there is a clear path.

Descending down the ladder, the group enters a room that is perfect metal sphere, with the only opening the one they just came through. In the center of the room is an octagonal panel that has 9 enameled slots, a blue one in the center and then one on each side that are purple (1), blue (2), blue (3), green (4), purple (5), green (6), blue (7), and blue (8).

docs.title: Exploring the facility
docs.text:
Cligs inserts the blue keycharm into slot 3, the room begins to vibrate and then rotate around opening onto a new hallway. Exploring this new area they come upon a large room that is filled with shelves and shelves of clean bedsheets, towels, blankets, and clothing. The room is completely spotless and a pleasant smell fills the air. They find a washbasin on the far wall that appears filled with clear water. Taking a drink out of it, Caelin find it is the best tasting water they have ever drank. They decide to scoop up a flask of it and then the group goes back to the rotator room.

Next, they try slot 7. The room again comes to life and the entryway rotates to a small hallway that leads to what appears to be an administrative office with shelves filled with books and scrolls, it also has a dead woman laying on the desk on top of a scroll. Cligs examines the desk and the dead clerk, while Caelin, Cassian, and S.A.M. each take a section of the bookshelves and they spend 10 minutes searching. The find:

  • Cligs finds a scroll of protection from energy and a House Cannith signet ring. The desk is filled with mundane office supplies (papers, ink, etc.)
  • Caelin and S.A.M. find that most of their books and scrolls deal with records of shipments of goods to the facility, ledgers on projects, etc.
  • Cassian finds much the same as the other two, but he also finds a special section detailing projects from other Cannith Enclaves. One item in particular stands out, it's called "Special Autonomous Model Project". Cassian puts this scroll in his pocket and says nothing about it.

docs.title: Woof woof
docs.text:
Heading back to the rotator room, they now try slot 8. Entering the hallway they notice streaks of blood down the hallway leading to the center of the three rooms at the end of the hall. They also hear the unmistakeable sound of wolves at play coming from the left room. The third room appears locked. Cligs cast an illusion to obscure them from the wolves while Caelin scouts the room. As they are sneaking past the two wolves, a third wolf comes out of the room. Caelin says "Who's a good boy?" using Speak with Beast and she responds back, in Common, "Thanks, but it's good girl." This is Rorsa, she explains how she "awoke" four years ago and how she learned how to use the keycharms and make her way around the facility. She takes care of the two younger pups, that she calls her children. She tells them about a dangerous moving fire in the NE wing of the facility (slot 2) and also asks the party to help her free the other wolves trapped in the kennels, being kept there by a hideous beast. She offers a green keycharm and a special magic item she found if they help her.

After agreeing to help her, she leads them to the kennels. They go back to the rotator room and she puts a green keycharm into slot 6. This leads them down a hall and to a second rotator room. This one has a metal square with 4 enameled slots : yellow, blue, orange, green. She leads them further on and they can hear the howling and barking of a number of wolves. As they approach the kennels they can see that 11 kennels line the walls, 7 of which are still occupied with angry wolves. There is also what appears to be a wolf made of stone standing in the center of the room, this is the monster Rorsa warned them about. The group is able to dispatch the wolf and Rorsa takes charge of the wolves and says she will care for them. She gives them a green keycharm and a pearl of power. In the kennels they also find a pile of debris the stone wolf was laying on, in it they find an orange keycharm, a strange metal disc, a House Cannith signet ring, and a mithral-and-bloodstone brooch. She also tells them that the third room in her hallway she has never been in as it's locked with a purple keycharm. Finally, she says that the slot 4 key in the first rotator room leads to a third rotator, but she never had the right keycharms for that room and that at least one of them is red.

docs.title: "I'll never let go, Jack"
docs.text:
The group heads back to rotator room two and decides to try their orange keycharm, which leads them to a door that is sealed with a yellow keycharm. The group decides to check out the third rotator room first, heading there they find another square with 5 enameled slots: red in the center, then green, orange, yellow, brown. They try the orange keycharm, immediately the room is plunged into darkness and the floor drops out from under them. Cassian and Cligs are able to grab onto the podium and save themselves. Caelin and S.A.M. plunge into a well of freezing water, Caelin can feel the cold immediately starting to seep into their skin. With Cligs and Cassian's help they are both able to climb out of the water and use the green keycharm to go back to the hallway.

The group heads back to Rorsa's den and decide to try the third room. They don't have the purple keycharm, but S.A.M. tries to use Knock to get in. They let out a tremendous gong - scaring the two wolves - which shatters the enamel lock and the door pops open. This room appears to be a well appointed with nice furnishings and well made weapons and armor adorning the walls. Searching the room carefully they find:

  • a greatsword, a longsword, and a shortsword. These are a matching set, exquisitely crafted by a Cannith artisan and inlaid with mithral tracery.
  • A chainmail shirt armor of gleaming
  • A shield baring the Cannith seal
  • 25 pp and a silver ring set with a bloodstone
  • A Darkweave cloak (+1 to stealth checks)
  • A potion of hill giant strength and a vial of oil of sharpness
  • A yellow keycharm

docs.title: That's bright, yo
docs.text:
Taking the yellow keycharm, the group heads back to that locked door they found. Using the keycharm on the door, they find that the room beyond is filled with mirrored walls and there is a massive ball of bright light. Stepping into the room the group finds that all sound is blocked out, which goes away when they step out. The living color spray is busy bouncing around the mirrors and doesn't take notice of the group at first. They see a door beyond the room and realize they need to deal with this threat. S.A.M. destroys several of the mirrors which ends the deafening effect.

Eventually, after defeating the living spell, they enter the room beyond. They face a room that appears to be filled with extreme heat and fire, but they don't feel any heat or smell any smoke. They quickly realize that this is an illusion, clearly showing somewhere else in the facility. They also notice a clear chest that seems to hold the diamond-shaped schema they are looking for. A final inspection also shows them that the only thing in the room that is real is a red keycharm hanging on the wall.

docs.title: H-O-T-T-O-G-O
docs.text:
The group heads back to the third rotator room. Cligs' thinks of putting the red keycharm in first, which when they do they hear a loud click. When they then use the orange keycharm again the room comes to life and rotates to a new hallway this time. Heading down the hallway they see a set of double doors and can see and feel intense heat radiating off of the doors. They decide to have Caelin stealthily sneak in and check things out and, if possible, grab the chest. Opening the doors they find two fire elementals roaming the corners of the room, in the center is a large crucible filled with bubbling molten glass radiates terrible heat. Long, snaking heads made of iron and brass rise up from the molten pool like some metal hydra. The crystalline chest is past this. Caelin also notices that the room appears to have a domed ceiling. They attempt to life the chest but find that it is far too heavy to do so. Instead, they pick the lock and remove the contents to the bag of holding:

  • 2 copies of the schema and the creation pattern they belong too
  • 2 potions of fire resistance
  • 2 potions of greater healing
  • a spell scroll of protection from evil and good

Having had to stop and stay to open the lock, Caelin's invisibility drops and the elementals immediately notice them and charge. The elementals pursue Caelin as they attempt to flee to the rotator room. The group is eventually all able to get into the rotator room and and activate the green keycharm to close out the elementals.

At this point, the team decides it's time to go. They make their way back to the main rotator room and use the center blue slot to access the ladder. They climb out and S.A.M. send a message to Failin to ask if they are still there. He responds yes, so they decide to head out. As they exit the cavern they hear from a familiar voice “Well done, adventurers.” Arrayed before them is six Emerald Claw soldiers armed with crossbows, four skeletons armed with scythes - one of whom is holding Failin and one Cornelius, and a female necromancer. The vampire is nowhere to be seen, but you can hear his voice.

“It is futile to fight us,” the vampire says. “Give me the third schema, and I will let you live. Oppose us, and I will take it from your corpses, and then raise your bodies to serve me.”

docs.title: 7 - 8 Olarune
docs.text:
Exiting the cavern, the party is faced with the Order of the Emerald Claw before them, they can hear but not see the vampire Garrow talking to them and demanding the "third" schema. They quickly converse and S.A.M. advises that they give up one of the copies of the diamond-shaped schema that they recovered in order to get out of this alive. The group agrees and Caelin hands over one of the copies to the closest soldier. Once they have it, Garrow reveals themself and tells them they made the right choice. He, the necromancer, and several of the soldiers mount up on their horses and prepare to leave. As he rides off, he shouts out to the remaining soldiers "kill them all!" The party, and Failin, are able to fight off the remaining soldiers and skeletons and Failin is ready to get out of there.

Luckily, the journey back through the Mournland is far less treacherous than it was coming to Whitehearth. The land cart knows the land now and is able to backtrack through the dangers the party already cleared. They see some of the same sights they passed on the way in but are able to avoid and direct conflicts. They finally break through the mists and back into Darguun at around 3am. They are able to convince Failin to take them back to Rhukaan Draal in exchange for some of the items they found and a letter of reference from Elaydren. With that, they decide it well past time for some rest.

In the morning, Cornelius identifies the Talaen Kara and shares what he finds with the others. They also discuss what they are going to give to Failin in exchange for the travel and settle on the chainmail armor of gleaming that they recovered. Eventually they break camp and start the journey back to the capital. Failin insists on traveling most of the day to put as much distance between them and the Mournland as possible and they don't make camp until 11pm that evening. S.A.M. takes this time to give Failin the armor of gleaming and discuss asking Elaydren for the letter of reference, which seems to please Failin for now.

docs.title: 9 Olarune
docs.text: The group travels most of the day and are fortunate to not run into any issues on the journey. When they break to make camp, Caelin asks Cornelius, as a fellow old, about their thoughts on the war and how Cannith contributed to it.

docs.title: 10 Olarune
docs.text:
The last day of travel, they should reach Rhukaan Draal late that evening and then will need to meet with Elaydren at the inn they pre-arranged with her, the Crossed Hammers. Caelin takes this morning to investigate the chest behind Failin's seat where he put Olladra's Chalice and the armor of gleaming. They notice that it doesn't appear to be locked, magically or otherwise, but that there is Abjuration magic emanating from it.

Several hours into the journey, several of the group notice dark shapes in the sky that appear to be following them and getting closer. Eventually, they are able to make out two griffon's bearing down on them, no doubt looking to make them a meal. In the confusion of this approaching threat, Caelin takes the opportunity to steal the chalice from Failin - which triggers a blaring Alarm and immediately alerts Failin to what they did. Failin refuses to move the cart further until the chalice is returned, even with the threat of the griffons bearing down on them. Cligs is almost taken away as a snack, but Cassian is able to save them from the beasts claws and eventually S.A.M. is able to scare them away. Turning back to the issue at hand, Caelin agrees to pay Failin 10 platinum in exchange for the chalice, twice the original bargain. Failin agrees to these terms but makes it clear he wants nothing to do with the party after they part ways in the city.

Arriving back in Rhukaan Draal, they part ways with Failin and tell him they will send the letter of reference from Elaydren, if she agrees, to the tavern where they met. They then go to meet up with her. They find her sitting in the back of the Crossed Hammers, looking more like herself but dressed in plain travel clothes. They debrief her on the situation with Garrow and give her both the schema and the creation pattern. She seems distressed about the fact that the Emerald Claw is now also in the mix of this hunt and it seems has at least one other schema, but is bolstered by the discovery of the creation pattern. She gives them the 2,000 gold reward she promised and offers them an additional 1,000 gold to help safely return her to Sharn, where she intends to go on the offensive against the Emerald Claw and Garrow.

docs.title: 11-14 Olarune
docs.text:
Elaydren books the group on the sea voyage home, the same route they took to get to the goblinoid city. On the journey back, several conversations take place:

  • Caelin talks to Elaydren about S.A.M. peculiar affinity for House Cannith and tries to understand why that is. She admits that she doesn't know, it's unusual but she has run into a few warforged in her time that hold the house in high regard. She doesn't know a specific reason why S.A.M. would feel this way. They seem to believe what she says.
  • Caelin also talks to Cornelius and asks for the artificer's help in deciphering the mysterious disc that they found in Whitehearth. He is able to identify it as a piece of warforged equipment, imbued with stealthy properties.
  • Cassian shows Cligs the scroll he found in Whitehearth, Special Autonomous Model Project, and asks for her help in studying it and for their discretion in keeping it to the two of them.
  • Cassian goes to Caelin and asks their permission to take the chalice and take some time to ponder his connection with the Sovereign Host and why he felt a connection to the chalice in Rose Quarry. Caelin agrees and gives Cassian the chalice.

docs.title: Olarune, Therendor, and Eyre
docs.text:
After arriving back in Sharn, Elaydren again tells the group to check in regularly at a Sivis message station and she will let them know when she has more information. It takes several months for her to reach out to the whole group again. In the interim, they each tend to their own interests:

  • Caelin: Finds a master of the scimitar to give them lessons in the martial weapon. They also spend a fair amount of time searching for a magical scimitar and are able to secure one at a great price! (Proficiency with Scimitars, +1 Scimitar)
  • S.A.M.: He spends he time as he usually does, taking care of Cassian. He also asks leave to spend time with Lady Elaydren, which Cassian approves. During his time with her, the two spend a lot of time talking about House Cannith and forming a closer bond. Eventually, Elaydren shares the whole truth with him about the fractures within her house and also that she is secretly working for Merrix d'Cannith, the Barron Cannith South. Because of her honesty, S.A.M. decides to share everything with her, and gives her a full accounting of their journeys as well as all of the information on the ir'Bellonas.
  • Cornelius: He has gained a taste for adventure and wants to improve his presence as a book returner for the library. He goes on several missions with the more seasoned returners, the meanest of the bunch, and as a result has become a more Intimidating librarian (Proficiency in Intimidation).
  • Cassian: He does spend some time contemplating the Sovereign Host and sends a prayer up to Olladra....and then uses the ritual taught to him by the Forgotten Prince to attempt to send him the chalice. This time as he sits and does the ritual as instructed, after the cold and swirl of ice, the chalice vanishes. He doesn't immediately hear from the Prince, but he does feel different...stronger.He also works with Cligs to decipher the scroll he took from Whitehearth. Together, they find out that House Cannith created a series of warforged that were different than the rest, not built for combat but for infiltration. These were given as "gifts" to various noble houses and important figures across Khorvaire during the Last War. They also learn that each of these was imbued with a secret code phrase that when spoken to them would "activate" them. The scroll did not contain the code phrases, what activation means, but it did contain a list of some of the models that were created and it included S.A.M. - Special Autonomous Musician, given to House ir'Bellona.
  • Cligs: In addition to helping Cassian, she spends much of this downtime researching the nature of the elementals bound to devices and vehicles that she encountered on their journey, trying to decipher if there is a way she could have taken control of Failin's cart. In her studies she learned that it is impossible to take command of such a vessel without the appropriate dragonmark to command the elemental. Additionally, she learned that their containment is within a physical place and it is possible to release them by destroying that containment, similar to how the fire elementals were released when the crucible was destroyed.

docs.title: 11 Eyre
docs.text: As Cassian falls asleep, he once again finds himself feeling the now familiar sensation of falling into the courtyard of the Castle of Lost Things. As he makes his way to the throne room he sees many new items strewn about, but the one that catches his eye is Olladra's Chalice on a podium bathed in moonlight. Meeting with the Prince this time, Cassian is more confident. The Prince thanks him for his service and hopes that they can continue their partnership. As promised, he gives Cassian more power, touching his shoulder he can feel coldness radiating through his body and then, suddenly, tendrils of ice flare out in all directions. The Prince says "Use it well," and as he lifts his hand Cassian finds himself back in a dream about Arcanix where he is giving a presentation but he has no pants on and his teeth are falling out.

docs.title: An intervention...but a bad one
docs.text:
Cligs decides it's time to lay everyone else's cards on the table and so invites Cassian to dinner at the tavern she works at and also send messages to S.A.M. and Caelin telling them that Vilroy has a job for them and to meet at the same tavern, slightly later. When Cassian arrives Cligs presses him that they need to tell S.A.M. about his nature and what they uncovered in the scroll. She also confronts him about his "demon" that he seems to be listening to more and more and how that could be dangerous. Cassian is more open about the Forgotten Prince but doesn't reveal all. He also reluctantly agrees to talk to S.A.M. about what they found out.

When the others arrive, Cligs informs them that this is an intervention for both S.A.M. and Cassian. She dives into spilling the information she learned about S.A.M and what she believes about Cassian. A lengthy, awkward, conversation ensues in which S.A.M. states that he is aware of jos nature but isn't bothered by it and doesn't understand why the others would be concerned. Caelin reveals the nature of Cassian's patron as an Archfey. Everyone agrees that they want to work towards more self-determination for the Warforged and the possibility of creating more.

As they conversation dies down, a strange figure throws open the doors of the tavern. Taking up most of the frame is a large creature that appears made of stone, with massive wings. As it enters the tavern, most patrons pay it no mind - gargoyles, while not common, are not unknown in the city. It approaches the table and in a voice that sounds like rocks smashing together says "S.A.M.?" When S.AM. affirms his identity, the creature hands him a letter and then departs. It is from Elaydren and simply states:

"My friends,

Meet me at Ertur's Shield, Sword Point, Middle Central tomorrow. The time to strike back is at hand.

Your patron, Lady E"

On the walk back to their quarters, Cassian and S.A.M. have a tense exchange around the information that was revealed at the table. In no uncertain terms, S.A.M. threatens Cassian that if he tells his family about S.A.M.s nature and loyalties, S.A.M. will reveal knowledge to the family that will outcast Cassian. Cassian asks him to stay elsewhere that night.

docs.title: 12 Eyre
docs.text:
When they meet at the Ghallanda-run tavern the next day, a young halfling server escorts them back to a private room that has Elaydren and a mysterious Elven woman sharing a bottle of wine. The server takes their orders and leaves, returning a few minutes later with their drinks and an array of food. Elaydren waits until he leaves to begin speaking.

She tells them that since they returned she has been preparing to strike back at the Emerald Claw and that her House Thuranni associate has collected information on Garrow's plans and now is the time to strike. She asks them if they will take the mission before proceeding further. When they finally agree, she tells them that Garrow has been seeking magic artifacts from deep under Sharn, one of these was a sword in the possession of an ancient vampire that has since seem to gone missing. She asks the Elf to explain more. Elaydren refuses to reveal her identity, and she doesn't offer one, so S.A.M. suggests giving her the codename "Nightingale". She reveals the following information - after the first she is able to produce a lifelike image of them using illusion magic:

  • Calderus. Ancient vampire. Based in the undercity of Sharn. Has agents throughout the city.
  • Lucan Stellos. Citadel agent in Sharn. Eight days ago multiple anonymous letters were sent to various officials. They revealed Stellos to be under the control of Calderus. Apparently, unwillingly.
  • Edvin Garm. Emerald Claw agent in Sharn. Eight days ago met with Stellos and passed him a letter. This occurred approximately an hour before Lucan Stellos was outed. Likely responsible for outing Stellos, but that is unconfirmed. Stellos disappeared within hours.
  • Garrow. Goes by “Brother” Garrow. Vampire. Not ancient. Priest of the Blood of Vol. Agent of the Emerald Claw. Was spotted in Korranberg six days ago. Nights, rather. Some Emerald Claw activity still going on there.
  • Grilsha Stellos. Lucan’s sister. Raised him. Very close. Protective. Lives in Ivy Towers. Magically talented.
  • Lucan reappeared the night before last. Seen at the residence of his sister. He had a magic sword in his possession. It matched the description of the one Garrow was studying. The vampire blade. Both Lucan and Grilsha disappeared that night. Last night, both of their residences were searched by agents of Calderus.

Elaydren will fill in the rest that they think Lucan and his sister are alive and on the run, likely to meet Garrow in Korranberg. She wants to part to head to the Zil city and disrupt his plans and, if possible, secure the vampire blade and bring it to her. She wants them to take the next airship to Korranberg, departing tomorrow around noon. She provide them with the following before they part ways:

  • 3 flasks of holy water
  • a wand of light bearing the mark of a House Cannith artificer
  • a pouch containing 45 pp and 50 gp
  • a letter of credit with House Ghallanda covering a week’s worth of room and board at the Korranberg Gold Dragon Inn.
  • Tickets for passage to Korranberg on the Cloud’s Destiny, a House Lyrandar airship

docs.title: 13 Eyre
docs.text:
The next morning, Cassian receives a sending from Cornelius, telling him that the Artificer has been called on for urgent assignment and will meet the group in Korranberg. Everyone else makes their way to Lyrandar Tower for their departure. The tower is very busy, with two airships docked and many people coming and going. In the crowd Caelin and Cassian spot the halfling server from the previous day, who seems to be waiting. Caelin goes to meet with the young man but as they do, the halfling takes off at a run. Caelin chooses not to pursue him and the group boards the vessel.

They are shown to their rooms, but S.A.M. and Caelin remain on deck to observe the other passengers. The vast majority are gnomes, there is also one dwarven woman. Caelin takes note of one gnome in particular who appears to also be watching the crowds and taking feverish notes in a notepad. They approach this gnome and attempt to question them but it appears the gnome wants to question them instead. They do learn that the man is apparently a reporter for the Korranberg Chronicle and after their conversation decides that they will write a story about warrior priests invading Zilargo.

"Gertrude", a gnome that definitely isn't just Cligs in disguise, also appoaches this gnome and tries to get information from him. She doesn't learn much more except that in them time she he spoke to Caelin he has become fascinated with S.A.M. Cligs also decides to spy on the dwarven woman, who is the only passenger who has not come out of their cabin. Using Find Familiar, she has a lizard sneak out the porthole in her room and look into the dwarven woman's. It seems like nothing peculiar is happening in here, except that she does seem to be talking to a bag.

docs.title: It's a bird? No, definitely halflings and warforged coming to kill us
docs.text:
Not long into their flight, as they are flying over the King's Forest, passengers begin to notice strange "birds" that seems to be following along their path. Eventually these are close enough to realize that they are halflings mounted on some sort of creature and a group of warforged riding hippogriffs. The captain orders passengers to their quarters and crew to their stations. Obviously, our group ignores that and heads up on deck. Six of the halfling riders are circling the ship, shooting at the crew and party. The four warforged land on the deck and immediately seek out the party, once again paying particular attention to S.A.M.

The dwarven woman also comes up on deck to face the boarders. Eventually, the illusion this woman has been maintaining drops and the party can see that this is Grilsha, the sister of Lucan that they learned about yesterday.

The party, crew, and Grilsha all work together to defeat the warforged and most of the halflings, the remainder who flee. As combat is ending but before the group has a chance to connect again and discuss what happened, a strange mist of ice begins to swirl around Cassian. Everyone can hear a voice that is unknown to them, except for Cassian, say "I need your help" and a moment later Cassian is gone.

docs.title: 13 Eyre
docs.text: The battle concluded, the group takes stock of their situation. No one seems too concerned about Cassian, assuming he will show up again at some point - though hopefully not in the same spot. The captain makes an announcement letting the passengers know that danger has passed, the ship will stop for an extended stay in Trolanport to be inspected for damage and offers to transfer anyone who no longer wishes to fly to a House Lyrandar galleon to complete the journey by sea, which will take longer. He then approaches the group and thanks them for their help. He offers them a reward if they will continue on with the ship after Trolanport as extra security - the group agrees.

docs.title: We know who you are
docs.text:
Back below deck, they attempt to speak with Grilsha who initially won't open the door for them. Eventually they name drop her and her brother and she opens the door for them. The group attempts to get her to trust them and to give them information by revealing what they know. Grilsha is unmoved by this and is adamant that she is heading to Korranberg on vacation and that she has not seen her brother in several weeks and has no idea what he has been up to. She does remind them that he works for the King's Citadel, so it's possible he is on a mission for the king and not to get in the way.

The group is unable to convince Grilsha or see through any deception she may be presenting them with. S.A.M. resorts to telling her he will stand outside her door until she comes to her senses. Cligs manages to sneak her familiar into Grilsha's room during this conversation. S.A.M. is true to his words and stands outside her door. Cligs periodically swaps senses with the lizard to check out what is happening but it generally is the same scene, she is keeping to herself and occasionally talking quietly out loud.

At dinner time, a crew member comes to bring Grilsha a meal since she didn't feel comfortable leaving the cabin. On his way out, he tells S.A.M. that she would like him to leave and she is making her uncomfortable. In turn, S.A.M. implies to the crewman that he believes Grilsha was an inside operative on the attack on the ship and provides his "evidence" and encourages the crewman to take this news to the captain - he says he will.

docs.title: Gottem!
docs.text: Shortly after dinner, Cligs does another swap senses with the lizard and this time is surprised to find that a man is in the room with Grilsha. She attempts to get the lizard close enough to hear what they are saying but in doing so the man notices the familiar and snatches it up and crushes it. The sensation is jarring for Cligs but she also had a chance to see the man's face - it's Lucan Stellos. She rushes to the door and calls S.A.M. over to share the news with him and figure out how to deal with this. They decide to confront them now and go to do so; however, they find that the room is wide open and appears to be empty. S.A.M. decides it's time to bring the captain in on this and goes up to his cabin to speak to him. When he enters, he is surprised to find two armed guards and Grilsha, the captain seems quite angry. As S.A.M. begins to explain the situation the captain cuts him off. The captain says that Grilsha has explained that S.A.M. has been harassing her and making her uncomfortable. He orders S.A.M. to be confined to his quarters for the remainder of the journey and an armed guard will be stationed there to ensure that they don't bother Grilsha anymore. As the captain is signaling to his guards to take S.A.M. away he is able to discern that captain seems altered from the last time they spoke with him. S.A.M. decides to go along with this for now, he returns to the cabin and fills the others in on what happened.

docs.title: 14 Eyre
docs.text: The next morning, the ship pulls into Trolanport and docks at the airship dock. The captain announces that they will be staying for most of the day, departing in the late afternoon, and that anyone who wishes to transfer to a sea vessel can do so. Many passengers disembark at this point. Cligs and Caelin observe the passengers, looking for Grilsha, Lucan, or Grilsha in disguise - they also spot a familiar face. Cornelius finished his task for the library and was able to call in a HUGE favor to make sure of teleportation from Sharn to Trolanport. They don't see anything strange amongst the passengers leaving and take Cornelius to their cabins to fill him in on everything. Cligs decides to set an alarm spell outside Grilsha's door to trigger if she leaves. There are no disturbances throughout the day. As the ship takes off for the remainder of the journey, Cligs decides to setup another familiar to take a look inside Grilsha's cabin. Maneuvering the creature up to the porthole and peaking inside she finds the cabin is empty! The personal effects and uneaten meal from the previous night remain on the desk, but no people to be seen. Cligs attempts to have the familiar sneak into the cabin's quarters but it is once again seen and destroyed.

docs.title: Detective Caelin on the Case
docs.text: Caelin heads up to the deck to where they know Grilsha was in the last 24hrs hour and uses their Clue spell to see her footsteps. They follow these down to her cabin and look around. They seem to eventually leave several hours later with a second set next to them and so Caelin follows them. The steps lead directly up to the captain's quarters and then never appear to exit. Caelin returns and shares this information with the group and they all decide it's best to leave it for now and deal with it when they arrive in Korranberg.

docs.title: My bad...
docs.text: Shortly after dinner there is a knock on the door at S.A.M. cabin, when he open the door an armed guard is there - not the one that had been in the hall previous, that guard seems to be gone. This guard, Steve Rogers, says that the captain requests S.A.M. presence in their cabin. S.A.M. agrees to go and the others come with. In the captain's quarters it is a very different scene than 24 hrs previously - the captain seems confused and apologetic about what happend with S.A.M. He says that the woman came in with a man and the two of them convinced him that S.A.M. was a problem and that they needed to keep him away from her - then the man disappeared. He also let them know that she remained in his cabin the rest of the night and then in the morning she disguised as one of the gnome passengers and left the boat. He offered them 500 gp as both an apology for the issue and as a request to keep this between them. He also agrees to give the group the information and contact of the captain of the sea vessel and also warn that captain.

docs.title: 15 Eyre
docs.text: The remainder of the journey passes without issue. Upon arrival in Korranberg's industrial district the captain gives them the name of The Sovereign's Storm's captain, Thariv d'Lyrandar. They group also asks the captain if there is a place where unsavory sorts gather for jobs and information, he directs them to the Wanton Fool, a nearby inn that caters to outsiders and smugglers. He also warns them to be careful to not run afoul of The Trust.

docs.title: This drunk idiot
docs.text:
The group make their way to the Wanton Fool Inn, S.A.M. decides to leave the group there and go check out the docks while they ask around inside. Cligs orders several shots and beers for the other two and tries to chat up the barkeep for information. After being unsuccessful at first, she presses further and mentions the Emerald Claw and tries to give the barkeep a 5gp bribe. At this, the barkeep tells her she should be careful with what she says and starts looking around the bar and then walks away - leaving the tip behind. Caelin notices that several nearby patrons have noticed this interaction and are watching them now.

Meanwhile, S.A.M. deploys his forked tuning rod tongue to cast Locate Object and tries to find an icon of the Emerald Claw. As he moves around the docks he gets a few hits on this spell, one coming from the dock area and two others coming from within the district. As he makes his way back to the group he keeps checking for more sources. When the group reconvene in front of the Inn they are hit with an uncomfortable feeling of multiple messages bombarding them at once, all saying "Welcome to Korranberg. e are peaceful folk and this is a peaceful city. You, too, will be peaceful while you are here, one way or another." At this moment, Cornelius plumbs the depths of his knowledge to recall his live in Zilargo and remembers that the Trust is Zilargo's secret police and that they ensure peace by operating a massive network of spies, informants, and assassins - and that they are not one to mess around. S.A.M. decides to leave the Trust a note explaining their business and then the group heads out to investigate one of the signals S.A.M. was picking up on.

They head out and eventually arrive at a tavern called the Lewd Pirate. It's shabbier than the Wanton Fool and rowdy on the inside, it is also very busy. There is a musical duo playing bawdy sea shanties riling up the crowd. S.A.M. asks the group if he can play a few songs and they are fine with his, he chooses several songs that include words like "Claw" and "Emerald" and the others watch the crowd to see if there is any response. They eventually think they have identified the Emerald Claw agent who is in the corner with another person. As they get up to leave, Cligs decides she should help separate them so that the others can deal with the Emerald Claw agent. She starts hitting on the other man and, when he seems uninterested in her, eventually manages to display an unnatural and horrendous ability to make herself vomit on this man - it's disgusting but effective, he leaves his friend to go to the back and the other man leaves the tavern.

Caelin follows the Emerald Claw agent as he makes his way through the industrial district. They are able to remain stealthy as they keep a close watch on him. The agent eventually makes their way to the airship docking station and up to a carriage dispatcher. They are able to overhear that the man requested a carriage to the Karrnath Embassy.

docs.title: 15 Eyre
docs.text:
As dusk begins to fall across the city, Caelin rejoins the group at the Lewd Pirate and stats to fill them in on where the second gentleman went. As they are speaking a somewhat familiar swirl of ice forms in the air and pop Cassian reappears before them. S.A.M. quickly attempts to distract from this scene and get the group to move to their inn to continue the conversation.

The group heads to check-in and debrief on what they learned, what happened to Cassian, and what their plans are. Cligs convinces the halfling behind the front desk of the Gold Dragon Inn to upgrade them to nicer rooms. The group discuses their options and decides to head out to scope out both Embassies.

docs.title: Old Town, Korranberg
docs.text:
Both embassies are located in the Old Town district, a few blocks from each other. The first stop at the Aundairian Embassy and notice that it has scaffolding being taken down and a fair number of guards. They see signage indicating that a Masquerade Ball is being held on 17 Eyre to celebrate the opening of the embassy. Lots detect a lot of magic in and around the building. They also see a fairly well secured door set in the back wall on the opposite side of the building from the main gate.

They continue on to the Karrnathi Embassy, it is has brutalist style, mostly solid walls and tall columns decorating the outside of it. There are many guards stationed at the entrance and several groups of guards patrolling the outside. They decide to send Cligs' familiar to attempt to go inside the embassy and see what it can find. She has Lizzard McGuire crawl up the wall and into an open window while they sit and have traditional Karrn food at a nearby cafe - meat, cheese, and a chocolate-cherry cake. Cligs loses connection with the lizard when passing through a version of Mordenkainen's Private Sanctum. She is unable to connect to her and hopes for the best.

Cassian fills the group in on what happened to him in Thelanis. His patron needed him to deliver a message to Thelania, the Queen of Dusk, in the Moon Court. He didn't know why or what the message was and the whole experience was fast and weird. To him it was only a couple of hours, not days.

Eventually, Lizzard McGuire returns and meets up with Cligs. She is able to replay images to Cligs of what she saw for the 30 minutes she searched. The room she snuck in to was a sort of small barracks with room for 6 guests in bunk-beds. Snooping further, Lizzard found signs of Emerald Claw activity.

The group goes back and discuss their plans on what to do from here. They decide that their best option is to ambush Grilsha and Lucan when they arrive on the docks the next day. They create an elaborate plan where Caelin is disguised as Neya having a picnic lunch with Cornelius, Cligs is disguised as a gnome dock worker, and Cassian & S.A.M. are at a distance ready to attack. What could possibly go wrong!

docs.title: 16 Eyre
docs.text:
The group gets setup for their plan and head to the docks. "Neya" and Cornelius set up their picnic on the docks. Cligs, now disguised as a gnome, takes up position near where the ship will come in and starts moving boxes around. As the ship arrives and they start removing cargo and people start disembarking Cligs, nearby, notices a solitary human woman surveying the docks. She seems to notice "Neya" and then step away from the railing. A few moments later a well dressed sailor with a sword on his hip comes off the ship and approaches "Neya".

Before he can really say much S.A.M springs their Silence spell over the area which makes the sailor run back to the ship, drawing his weapon. As soon as he breaks the barrier of the spell he starts shouting "to arms, we're under attack!" As he retreats up the gangway, continuing to call out to take up arms, sailors take up positiona on the boat with crossbows. A few moments late House Lyrandar guards come out from a guard house to support the vessel and secure the docks.

"Neya", Cornelius, and Cassian make an escape in a carriage - the latter two making a show of "protecting the ambassador." They get a message from S.A.M. saying to head to the Aundairian embassy and start staking it out. Cligs remains for a bit to see what happens but eventually Cligs also leaves and makes her way to the embassy. S.A.M. stays to watch until the boat leaves, he sees no sign of anything suspicious and never sees anyone make a last minute escape.

docs.title: Back in Old Town
docs.text:
Back at the Aundairian Embassy, the crew again takes up a position in a nearby cafe and scope out the scene. They see that the scaffolding has further been disassembled and that there is a constant stream of workers coming and going. The guards seem to check IDs and papers for everyone that comes into the facility.

Cligs sends Lizzard over the outer wall to get more information. She sends her back images of the real Neya working in her office, seemingly alone. She sees a courtyard busy with workers setting up and guards at each entrance.

Cassian and Cligs decide to go to try and get an audience and perhaps an invitation to the Ball. Cligs disguises as a gnome manservant, Philip Crinklebottom - basically the gnome version of S.A.M. They approach the guards and Cassian uses his family name and his time studying at Arcanix to secure a meeting with Jayres Tachiot, the majordomo of the embassy. They are not able to meet with Neya but do get some information about the Ball as well as secure 3 invitations to the even. On the way out, Cligs "fakes" a tumble and drops Lizzard McGuire on the floor on their way out.

docs.title: 16 Eyre
docs.text: Having secured three invitations and left Lizard McGuire behind as a spy, Cassian and "Philip" head back to meet up with Caelin and Cornelius, who seems to be thoroughly enjoying the Aundairian pastries. As they arrive, S.A.M. also turns up and the they all fill each other in on what they were up to while they were apart. Cligs is pretty sure that, with help from Caelin, they can magically forge another 2 invitations if they need them. S.A.M. decides that it might be best for him to try and secure another real one, in order to limit things that can go wrong. The group splits up again, with S.A.M. heading to the embassy and the rest of the group going to look for costumes and masks for the upcoming ball.

docs.title: A vision of home
docs.text: S.A.M. presents himself to the guards and tells them that he is looking to offer his services at the ball as an entertainer. They tell him that the embassy has already booked "The Marionettes" for the ball, but after a brief conversation he is able to convince them to let him speak with Jayres about other opportunities. S.A.M. is led to the majordomo's office and he again offers his services for the event. Jayres humors him and allows him to audition. The traditional Aundairian piece that S.A.M. plays is performed so well that it moves the man to tears and he agrees to pay S.A.M 10 gp and gives him the hour before the official ball start time, when guests are arriving, to play in the garden space. He also gives him an invitation in order to attend the party after performing.

docs.title: Queue the montage
docs.text:
Meanwhile, the rest of the group searches Old Town for an appropriate shop to buy costumes and masks for the event, eventually choosing "The Dapper Road", a high-end boutique that is specifically advertising attire for the masquerade ball. Inside the shop there are numerous outfits on display and a whole section devoted to attire fit for the ball. After browsing, they each decide on an outfit and mask:

  • Caelin:
  • Chose a flowing color-shifting purple [[common-glamerweave-erlw|Glammerweave]] gown adorned with embroidery in order to cover their armor and a plain black mask.
  • Cassian:
  • Decided he would wear the full glammerweave suit he already owns and purchased an eagle mask.
  • He also chose for S.A.M. an over-the-top. peacock mask adorned with feathers and a matching vibrant cloak.
  • Cligs
  • Thinking she will go to the ball as Philip Crinklebottom, she purchased a nice but relatively plain tunic and pants in House ir'Bellona colors and a bugbear mask.
  • Cornelius
  • Insists that he will go in his armor and helmet and didn't buy anything

Purchases done, the group heads back to their tavern to meet up with S.A.M. and discuss the plan for tomorrow.

docs.title: A quick stop
docs.text: After leaving their purchases in the tavern, Cassian and Caelin leave for one more quick errand and seek out an alchemist. They head to the nearby Central Market and are able to find a suitable shop, called "What Ails You" and ask the shopkeep for both a sleep potion, because Cassian can't sleep, and a poison, because Caelin has a rat problem. They head to the back and eventually return with two bottles: one marked with a skull and the other a question mark. The shopkeep says the question mark one is a sleep potion but that he can't guarantee how long it would work - hence the question mark. Cassian takes a whiff and it smells strongly of valerian root and other sleepy-time things. They pay and return to the tavern.

docs.title: 17 Eyre
docs.text:
Having most of the day to kill, Cassian, Caelin and S.A.M. decide to try and gather some information about other guests and go out to check in with a variety of clothing shops around Old Town to see if they can get information on what Brother Garrow or other potential targets might be wearing. They are able to hit up 5 such shops across the Aundairian and Karrnathi areas of Old Town. They are able to convince shop owners in all the stores to share some information about recent purchases but in reviewing the information they are only able to identify one person of interest: E. Garm who purchased a white wolf mask.

Unfortunately, Cornelius begins to suffer the consequences of over-indulgence yesterday and is confined to the privy. They group leaves him an invitation in case he is feeling better and can join them later.

docs.title: Pre-game
docs.text:
S.A.M. heads out before the rest of the group for his allotted time as an entertainer and sets up in the courtyard with a good view of the entrance so he can monitor who enters. As he arrives before any guests he is able to scope out the building and identifies the following:

  • Two pairs of guards: one at the main entrance and one and the barrier between the garden and ballroom (green bases 1-5)
  • A fifth guard stationed in the ballroom
  • Various members of staff setting up and getting carts of food ready in both spaces
  • A "stage" of sorts at the opposite end of the ballroom that the Marionettes are setting up on
  • Both areas are illuminated by dancing lights and floating everbright lanterns, casting the whole space in dim lighting.
  • And Jayres roaming about checking in on everything, who dons a green stag mask (on red base 13) before guests start arriving.

docs.title: The Guests
docs.text:
After a few moments guests begin to arrive and S.A.M. begins to play, making note of the guests as they come in.

  • The first pair are two Aundairian humans, a man and a woman with the woman hanging on the man's arm. They are both well dressed in expensive looking glammerweave clothing. The man wears a green dragon man (red base 7) and the woman a black cat mask (red base 9)
  • The next pair were two Zil gnomes, a man and woman, both wearing expensive looking clothing but the woman's attire significantly more showy. He is wearing a gold stag mask (red base 2) and she is wearing white swan mask (red base 6)
  • A solo male dressed in what appears by attire favored by Brelish nobility arrives and is wearing a black crow mask (red base 10)
  • A trio of Aundairian's arrive, a woman and two men. The woman is wearing nice, well made clothing but it is not overly showy and a blue dragon mask (red base 8). The two men are both wearing well fitting suits and plain black domino masks (red bases 3 and 12)
  • And finally, the rest of the party arrives

S.A.M. wraps up playing and begins to circulate the crowd, receiving compliments and invitations to perform from several. Cligs, disguised as "Philip", takes a moment once they are in the main ballroom to swap senses with Lizzard and get the information from her. She shows her a stream of information from the last day, mostly workers and delivery people coming and going and a few visits from Jayres to Neya. She also shows Cligs a visit to Neya from a House Lyrandar envoy. Eventually Lizzard is showing her a live feed of Neya's office and sees the woman pacing around, reading from a set of cards and speaking out loud - she is practicing her speech. Eventually Neya finishes and dons a gold dragon mask (red base 4) and heads out to the ballroom. Cligs uses this opportunity to have Lizzard search her desk where she finds a closed letter with the Karrnathi Seal on it. Lizzard is able to get this open and read the contents, which in brief say that E.G. will bring the papers to the masquerade ball.

docs.title: A toast and a lot of action
docs.text:
After most of the guests are in the ballroom and have had a chance to get a drink, Neya makes her entrance and heads up to the stage. She gives a brief message welcoming everyone to the ball and encouraging them to enjoy the evening.

30 minutes after the party begins two prominent guests arrive, a man in a well fitting suit wearing an eagle mask (red base 5) - actually the same one as Cassian, and a half-elf woman wearing an owl mask (red base 11). Other guests also come and go throughout the evening.

As the ball continues on the group notices that people are getting pretty raucous. There are several different dances and attempts at conversation - including an awkward attempt at being "Eagle Bros" from Cassian to the other guest in an eagle mask. Cassian attempts to see if he can identify any hidden weapons on the eagle man but isn't able to.

50 minutes into the event, the man in eagle mask and Neya share a lengthy dance and what appears to be an intense conversation. S.A.M. isn't able to pick-up anything by observing but he makes note.

60 minutes into the event, S.A.M. sees Neya speak with Jayres and decides to check in with the majordomo. While they are talking it seems that Jayres is a bit distracted, as if his mind is concentrating on something else. After a brief chat S.A.M. notices a grave look cross over Jayres' face and the man apologizes and goes to leave - S.A.M. gently encourages him to seek his help if it's needed.

Briefly after this, blue dragon mask asks eagle mask to dance. At the same time, Cligs asks owl mask to dance and begins an intense attempt to woo the half-elf into sharing more information. During the dance Cligs uses the cover of tossing her in the air to check for concealed weapon but finds something else - a messenger-style bag hidden under her clothing. She begins to question more and eventually is convinced that owl mask is none other than Grilsha. She begins trying to let the others know her thoughts. When Cassian comes over to the pair the woman seems to recognize him and leaves to return to the garden - convincing Cligs further of her suspicions.

75 minutes into the event, as owl mask is leaving Cligs, another guest arrives in a white wolf mask. He makes a quick round of ballroom and then goes to have a conversation with Neya. He eventually passes her what appears to be documents before heading off.

90 minutes into the event, Neya once again addresses the crowd. She delivers a brief speech thanking everyone again for coming, extolling the virtues of the work done by the architects in designing the space, and thanking the musicians for their wonderful performance. After she leaves the stage, eagle mask approached her for another conversation. As the two are talking the two Aundairian men in black domino masks approach him from behind and each put a hand on his shoulders. They say, loud enough for several others to hear around, "you must come with us," instead the man puts his hand out and what appears there is something the party has heard described - the vampire blade. He swings at the closest of the two men - chaos ensues.

docs.title: 17 Eyre
docs.text:
Lucan swings the vampire blade, striking the man closest to him and then moves across the ballroom towards the guard that is stationed there. Cornelius has arrived to ball, ready to dance but seems to walking in on something else entirely. Cligs takes a moment to take in the scene, specifically paying attention to the woman in the blue dragon mask and Edvin, he notices that both have drawn daggers at the scene before them and assumes that they are working together and shouts "They're Emerald Claw". S.A.M. and Caelin reposition within the ballroom and Cassian draws on his new power to shroud himself in icy-armor.

As combat breaks out the array of nobles, dignitaries, and other non-combatants panic and attempt to flee towards the exit - creating obstacles. As the scene continues to unfold sides are drawn:

  • Neya, though she initially appears to be helping Lucan, orders her guards to subdue him and seems to be helping the two Aundairians who approached Lucan.
  • Edvin appears intent on helping Lucan escape, engaging with Cassian and S.A.M. to distract them so he can escape
  • The guards seem divided, some of them are doing as one would expect - following Neya's orders, but a trio of guards seems intent on helping Lucan and engage with the Aundairian agents.
  • Grilsha is doing what she can to help her brother alternating between engaging with the players and also fighting the Aundairians.
  • Following Cligs' accusation, the mystery woman sends her a message that simply says "I'm with the Royal Eyes of Aundair, you idiot!" which seems to be enough to convince Cligs they are on the same side.

Eventually, desperate to escape, Lucan reveals the secret he's been trying to hide from the world - he is a vampire. He changes his form to that of a bat in attempt to get away. The group, mostly S.A.M., is able to continuously try and prevent Lucan from escaping by using Command. Panicked for her brother's safety, Grilsha unleashes two powerful Lightning Bolts into the crowd - obliterating several nobles and also downing Caelin. Cornelius administers a healing spell to bring Caelin back - but not before the Firbolg has a vision of a grey light pulling at them: Dolurrh - the Realm of the Dead was calling.

Despite their best attempts to subdue the siblings, both Lucan and Grilsha are able to escape. With both of them gone Meena, the Royal Eyes agent, and Jayres work to fix what Lucan did to the three guards and tend to the disaster before them. Edvin surrenders to Neya and she demands to know what the players were doing. S.A.M., having intentionally distanced himself from the others, is able to leave without questioning. For her part, Neya reveals that she didn't know Edvin was Emerald Claw until this evening and her plan had always been for the Royal Eyes to capture Lucan here. That failed, she tells the players that she gave Lucan papers and passage on a Lightning Rail headed to Karrnath leaving in the morning. She does say that the Royal Eyes will attempt to capture him as the train travels through Aundair but that the players are free to try as well - to aid them she gives them a letter of credit with House Orien to cover transport as well as two spellshards: Silence and Sleep. The group heads back to their tavern to squeeze in a nights rest before they catch the train in the morning.

docs.title: 18 Eyre
docs.text:
Having returned to the inn to recover from the battle at the Ball, morning dawns the group ready to get back on the hunt for Lucan and the vampire blade. S.A.M. has no interest in waiting for the rest of the group as they decide to wear disguises and so heads out to the station with the letter of credit to secure tickets.
