They decide that he will leave the rest of the groups tickets at the counter under the name "Mr. Underhill." The rest of the party decides to work on disguises:

  • Cligs disguises self as a gnome woman, Philipina Crinklebottom, perhaps?
  • Caelin disguises self as a half-elf woman with resting bitch face
  • Cassian has Caelin attempt to use their disguise kit on him, only for it to go awry and he ends up with bright red hair, a drawn on scar and instead of giving him defined cheekbones he is wearing bright red blush
  • Cornelius realizes that Grilsha and Lucan have never seen him, so he only is going to change the form of his armor. Cligs thinks this isn't enough and attempts to shave his long, flowing, grey locks - which causes Cornelius to punch her after he stops her.

At the station, S.A.M is told that there is space on the train for the group either in two sleeper cars, separated in standard class, or all together in steerage. He decides on one sleeper car for himself and gets the rest of the group steerage class tickets. When they arrive and pickup their tickets that are not happy to find out about where their seats are but given the train is about to leave they don't have a choice but to get on and deal. The train pulls out and starts its journey to Zolanberg and once they are on the move the group decides to explore:

  • S.A.M. heads to the dining car to sit and observe people as they move about. He notices an odd pairing in a Cleric of the Silver Flame and a Gnome that seem to be traveling and spending most of their time together.
  • Cornelius also makes their way to the dining car but seems mostly interested in sitting and reading a book
  • Cassian makes their way back to the cargo cars to take a look. In the first he finds mostly goods marked as supplies for the journey and some crates that identified only with an ID number. As he attempts to go into the second car he finds this one under guard by 4 House Orien guards. He, somehow, manages to convince them to let him take a look as he claims to be a vampire hunter and there is a rumor of vampires aboard. As he is escorted around he sees that there is mainly secure luggage that seems to belong to more well-off passengers as well as cargo that is only identified with a number but also locked. Curiously, there is a large empty space in the middle that seems like its waiting for something.
  • Caelin goes to seek out a conductor about getting an upgrade, they are eventually able to find one and secure an upgrade to a sleeper room - at almost double the cost it would have been at the ticket counter. On their way they pass through the galley and find two interesting passengers: one is a gnome that seems to be going on and on about Sharn and how excited they are for the journey; the other is human woman who seems to look remarkably like Neya, Caelin approaches this woman and she claims to be a cousin but that they aren't close and she wasn't at the Ball.
  • Cligs goes to make their way to the sleeper cars so that she can have Lizzard McGuire do some scouting. They cross paths with S.A.M. who lets them use the sleeper room to setup while Lizzard is scouting. Cligs has her do a loop around the sleeper cars and report back. She finds the one next door to have the window blocked, the next two are empty, and the last on on this side of the train has a pair of gnomes getting busy. On the opposite side the first room is empty, the next has a sleeping gnome, the next a half-elf woman that seems to be reading a book on the book of the history of the Brelish monarchy and the last two have the gnome and cleric S.A.M. met earlier.

At lunch time, Cornelius makes the acquaintance of the gnome that Caelin had met earlier and finds that her name is Evine d'Sivis and the two chat for bit. The others share what information they have gathered so far.

In the afternoon, the train arrives at Zolanberg, the third largest city in Zilargo, for an extended stop. While there, Cornelius is able to get an upgrade to standard class. Cassian decides to become a man of the common people and goes to smoke with some of the other steerage passengers. Caelin uses their expertise with mimicking hand writing to create two fake first class tickets with varying success.

S.A.M. hangs out on the platform observing and notices two strange, likely related, things. First, he sees cargo being loaded at the back of the train but, curiously, they seem to be taking grate care to keep whatever they are loading hidden by backing a covered wagon directly up to the side of the cargo car. Second, he sees a number of House Orien stewards loading baggage into the first class car but no passenger. He manages to convince one of these stewards to share some information, but unfortunately he doesn't know who the mystery passenger is but that they were told to load this cargo and that the passenger would join just before departure time. After being rebuffed from getting into first class by a train attendant, Cligs sets up Lizzard McGuire to be able to do a scout of the first class car and then spy to see who will be boarding. The group decides that the most likely place to find Grilsha is in the first class car and so plan to ambush her after the next stop in Sterngate, when they are in Breland and she may be sleeping. Just as the train is starting to power up and head out two figures board the train, first a strange man that boards the first class car. They do not recognize him but he seems dangerous, then a second person boards with a cloak pulled tightly up and around their face.

docs.title: What a coincidence
docs.text:
At dinner time, Cligs, S.A.M., and Cassian sit together and observe the dinning car where many passengers have come to eat and socialize. Cornelius asks Evine to dinner and escorts her there and sits at a table with her, separate from the group. Caelin remains in their room. As they are sitting, a somewhat familiar face walks into the dinning car and claims an empty table in the far corner of the car - it looks a lot like Brother Garrow, minus the vampiriness. A few minutes later, another familiar face appears in the car - Lucan Stellos. He looks anxious as he heads to sit with Garrow and talk.

Cligs takes this chance to see what Lizzard saw and she shows the mystery man appear to board and sweep the first class car and then go into room closer to the front of the car. She then sees Brother Garrow appear and enter the same room. A few minutes later she sees Garrow slip a note under the other first class door that appears to be glowing slightly.

Back in the present, S.A.M. seems ready to engage and sends a message to the cleric he met earlier and tells her that two of the vampires he told her about earlier are sitting behind her talking. She responds by reminding him that they are many innocents around and protecting them needs to be their first priority. He then messages Caelin and lets them know that Garrow and Lucan are in the dinning car. Cligs sees what is happening and decides it would be best to go to Grilsha and try and get her to help stop a fight from breaking out and she sprints off for the first class car.

Cligs uses one of the fake first class tickets to get into first class and talk to Grilsha, who lets the goblin in and the two talk. Grilsha is adamant that neither she or her brother knew Garrow was Emerald Claw and tells Cligs that there is no way her brother would ever agree to work with Garrow or give him the blade and if he found out Garrow was Emerald Claw things might go badly. She also tells Cligs that if she helps prevent a fight tonight Grilsha will try to convince her brother to give her party the blade, but that it wont be easy as it has started to corrupt his mind as it is sentient and has it's own will. Cligs agrees and heads back to the group trying to send messages letting them know not to fight.

Caelin approaches the dining car stealthily and takes a moment to look at the scene before entering. They notice that it seems like the conversation isn't going well. Lucan appears to be angry and Garrow appears frustrated, neither seems to be getting what they thought the would from the conversation. They join the group at the table. S.A.M. decides it's time to do something and goes to sit with the two. As he does, Lucan gets up to leave. S.A.M. attempts to convince/threaten him into staying to talk but he refuses and keeps heading out. Caelin attempts to Command him to stay, but he is able to resist. S.A.M. then turns to Garrow and tells him he knows what the man wants.

docs.title: 18 Eyre
docs.text:
S.A.M. begins to talk to Garrow, loudly accusing him of being Emerald Claw and a murderer in the hopes of getting Jaralie, the Cleric of the Silver Flame, to side with them. In turn, Garrow is professing his innocence and trying to get her to think S.A.M. is a liar. They come to a point where S.A.M. challenges Garrow to allow a third-party to inspect his belongings and the cargo he had loaded - Garrow accepts on the condition that the Conductor of the train is the third-party and that S.A.M. and the Jaralie can participate - he also denies that he has any cargo loaded on the train.

Meanwhile, Caelin goes to follow Lucan, still disguised as a sort-of-Lucan, and attempts to talk to him and try to stall until the others can catch up. Lucan does get distracted for long and quickly sets off again. Caelin attempts to pursue but loses Lucan in the Standard car, they are also unable to gain access to First Class. They decide to hop on the roof of the train and see what they can see from there.

Eventually, they see S.A.M., Jaralie, Cornelius, Cassian, and Garrow make their way through the First Class car and into the Helm. In the Helm, Garrow calls for the Conductor and S.A.M. begins to explain the situation. As he is doing so, the Conductor seems to be willing to be impartial and do this search as agreed. However, Garrow pulls a letter out of his pocket and hands it to the man. S.A.M. is able to identify the seal on the envelope is that of House Orien. The Conductor reads the letter and it's almost as if a switch flips, he is immediately on Garrow's side. He informs the group that the cargo that was loaded is the property of the nation of Karrnath and not this passenger. He also says that he will conduct a search, as agreed, but that neither S.A.M. nor Jaralie will be allowed to search anything. She also seems to be losing interest in this investigation. They go to the First Class car and enter Garrow's cabin, the other man is there reading a book. The Conductor does a cursory examination of the room and Garrow's belongings and then says that the matters is closed and everyone should go back to their ticketed cars. S.A.M and the others agree and head out.

Cligs was peeking out of the gnome-height peephole and spotted Cassian (his crotch) walking down the hallway, she grabbed him and S.A.M. and filled them in on her meeting with Grilsha and that she was willing to meet with Cligs in the morning to discuss getting him to turn over the blade in exchanged for helping to keep them safe. Everyone agreed she should take the meeting.

The train arrived at Sterngate a couple of hours after the party's altercation with Garrow and Lucan. The train only lingered here briefly to take on Darguul cargo as well as several Brelish soldiers and a number of Hobgoblins. The rest of the evening passed without incident.

docs.title: 19 Eyre
docs.text:
Cligs meets with Grilsha once again, initially disguised as Philip Crinklebottom but drops that disguise and reveals her true identity. She explains, without giving all the details, that their mission was to retrieve the vampire blade and, above all else, ensure that it does not fall in the hands of Brother Garrow. Cligs emphasizes that they don't wish to harm Grilsha or Lucan if they don't have to. Grilsha, for her part, says that she is sorry about what happened at the Ball, but protecting her brother and ensuring his safety is the most important thing to her. She shares with Cligs that the blade has a power over her brother and is influencing his mind. She also says that given his past, Lucan would never side with the Emerald Claw. They thought they were simply meeting a representative of Karrnath that would help them settle in - not an envoy of the Emerald Claw. Grilsha promises to help the party with convincing her brother to give up the blade and asks Cligs to return after dark to speak with them again. Cligs shares that Garrow has brought some sort of secret cargo on board and asks for her help in dealing with it should it become a problem, Grilsha agrees as long as it doesn't put Lucan in danger.

Back in Steerage, Cassian is continuing to attempt to become a "man of the people" and hanging out with DA BOYZ, his new posse of working class friends made up of Tommie, Robbie, and Four-Fingered Phil. S.A.M. is keeping his distance. Cligs, Caelin, and Cornelius make their way to Steerage to meet with everyone and discuss the meeting with Grilsha and their plan from here. Cligs gives the group the download of her meeting, leaving out the parts where she was hitting on Grilsha. They decide to go ahead with the meeting and to avoid any more confrontations with Garrow for now - but plan on taking him out as soon as possible. To that end, Cassian and Caelin go to make an attempt to scout out the cargo that was brought on. To support them, Cligs has summoned a new Familiar - a beaver, named Jennifer Beaver; she casts Invisibility on the creature so it can sneak in and help find out what is inside.

Cassian and Caelin are not able to convince the guards to let them in to inspect again, seemingly they have received updated orders not to let anyone in. They do manage to get the door opened long enough for Jennifer to sneak in and get to work.

The rest of the day passes by without much happening. Cornelius strikes up a conversation with one of the soldiers who boarded the night before. The man seems young, barely 19, and laments having only been able to join the military recently and not have had a chance to fight for the glory of Breland during the Last War. His name is Farnish Tells. Cornelius suggests to him that there might be trouble on the train and wonders if he could be relied on for support. The young man seems very eager but tells Cornelius he will only be on the train until Vathirond.

Before heading to the meeting with Grilsha, Cligs goes to check in with Jennifer and see what the creature has discovered. She connects and gets the download. Jennifer shows her scouting out the cargo hold, which looks much as Cassian described it previously only with more cargo. In the center there are several large creates and a tall object covered in a tarp. She sneaks under the tarp and sees a coffin, without its lid on and no one inside. She looks at the creates and they do indeed have "Property of Karrnath" stamped on them. She gets to work beavering into the tops of them. While she is work, she sees Garrow come back and take a moment at each of the crates and then head out. Catching up to the present, Jennifer has finally made a hole big enough to see, and hear, what is inside - undead soldiers. Cligs dismisses Jennifer and informs the others that Garrow has at least 20 undead soldiers in the cargo hold and has recently reasserted his control over them. They need to make sure that dealing with this is part of their plan.

docs.title: The Deal
docs.text:
The train pulls in to Starilaskur for an extended layover just as the sun is beginning to set. Evine leaves to catch her transfer to Sharn, promising to reconnect with Cornelius when he is back in Sharn. When darkness has set in the whole party heads out to meet with Grilsha and Lucan. Knocking at their door, she lets them in and takes up a position to keep them all in her line of sight. S.A.M. and Lucan do most of the talking. Lucan fills in more details about the situation, saying that he can't stay in Breland or travel through the nation, the King's Dark Lanterns will be hunting for him all across the nation. He reaffirms that he refuses to work with the Emerald Claw but still thinks Karrnath is the safest place for him to go.

Cligs shares the information she learned about the cargo, particularly about the empty coffin and the likelihood that it is intended as a way to trap and transport Lucan to Karrnath. As she is going over this information, a note is slid under the door, magically altered to grab attention. It's an invitation for another conversation with Garrow.

S.A.M. has an offer. Give up the blade and they can set him and Grilsha up with Cassian's family to keep them hidden. Elaydren can help with this and eventually he can move on with a new life. S.A.M. even says that he can keep on to the sword until they arrive at the estate. Lucan is initially hesitant, since this would still be in Breland, but is encouraged by the fact that House ir'Bellona is not a well known one and that his sister might be able to return to her life. Lucan's only modification to S.A.M. plan is that he would like to stay on the train until it crosses into Thrane as it will be safer and easier to avoid the Dark Lanterns there.

Lucan and Grilsha agree to the plan. It is decided that Lucan will go to the meeting with Garrow to keep him from feeling like he will be forced to act. Once the train crosses into Thrane, Cornelius we decouple the last cargo car and the party will confront Garrow, with Lucan and Grilsha's help, and then they will escape the train and make their way to Cassian's home.

docs.title: To Terminus! If we survive...
docs.text:
Alden d'Orien has taken his son and left Sharn to help the boy recuperate. The group knows that they need to get to Terminus to find the excavated items and stop Garra. Asking Vishtai about the best way to get there, he points them in the direction of Lyrandar Tower, where they can make use of Alden's private skycoach to take them to Terminus.

On their way to the tower, while crossing one of the bridge, they hear a familiar voice above them asking if they need a lift. Sergeant Vilroy is there with a skycoach of her own and she encourages the group to get on and fill her in. They at first seem hesitant to board but still fill her in on what they have been up to since they last met. She again encourages them to board and she will take them to Terminus. Cligs begins to notice that something doesn't seem quite right with "Vilroy" and begins questioning their paramour about their recent rendezvouses. At first "Vilroy" seems to be able to bluff their way through, but on sustained questioning they are flummoxed and instead of confronting the character they choose to jump off the skycoach - luckily clutching a feather token so they are able to safely escape to a lower level. They catch a fleeting glimpse as this impersonator melds into the crowd and notice that their shape has changed - a changeling. What happened to the real Vilroy?

They get back on the trek to find the Orien Skycoach when they are again ambushed by agents of Daask, a quartet of gnolls riding disks of green energy sweep zip between the towers and close in on them. Though the battle takes its toll on them, the group is able to eliminate 3 of the gnolls in short order and the last one flees.

Surely these issues aren't a sign of things to come...

docs.title: Terminus
docs.text:
Finally tracking down the Orien Skycoach and proving to the driver that they are on House Orien business, they are able to make their way to the top floor of Terminus. Terminus, in Lower Tavick's Landing, is named for Terminus Station, a massive House Orien enclave that serves as the endpoint for the Orien lightning rail. It bustles with crowds, pickpockets, con artists, and other criminals looking to take advantage of the city's visitors.

Trying to get to Garra as quickly as possible, the group tries to engage the nearby Sharn Watch in helping in their search, or at least stopping the trains, or maybe directions....anything? Though the guard is too frightened by the prospect of mixing with Daask to get involved himself he does give them directions to the floor where Garra's apartment is located and says he will send word to other Watch stations to be on the lookout for the half-ogress.

docs.title: She isn't getting her deposit back
docs.text:
The group knocks on a series of apartment door but most don't answer. At one of them, an elderly magewright named Martisha shouts at them to go away. Convincing her to hear them out and persuading her to give them information she informs them that Garra is her neighbor and there has been a lot of commotion in the apartment today and she would appreciate it if they kept it down.

The group circles back and is eventually able to get the door open. While exploring they are ambushed by four kenku assassins. In the midst of fighting the kenku are also joined by Nur, a gnoll who was in the other room of the apartment burning documents. The group endures another pitched battle but are thankfully aided by the timely arrival of members of the Watch. Exploring the apartment after the battle the group finds:

  • A badly battered Sergeant Vilroy, who has been rendered unconscious by oil of taggit
  • Records of the warforged that were employed in the excavation project
  • A ticket stub indicating that Garra is leaving on a lightning rail to Wroat in 2 hours

Having been roused by a handy Goodberry, the real Vilroy encourages them to quickly rest up and then get after Garra. She lets them know that there is a lift that will take them to the station level.

docs.title: Who designed this adventure?
docs.text: Vilroy also reminds them to be mindful of more Daask operatives which proves to be an apt warning. They almost immediately encounter a Harpy who attempts to lure them and a group of commoners into jumping over the end of a sky bridge. Luckily most of the group is able to resist her Song and save Cligs and the commoners and defeat the Harpy. They have another run in with a Daask shifter named Bartram and his worg companion but are luckily able to buy their way out of having to fight them. The room that Bartram was guarding also has a halfling tied to a chair who has clear been beaten for information. He initially claims to not know why he is there but eventually confesses to being a Boromar spy that was trying (and failed) to infiltrate Daask. They free him, learn his name is Corrin and he points them towards the lift to the station level.

docs.title: Garra, finally
docs.text:
Having made it to the station platform, the group hears the last call announcement for the lightning rail to Wroat. They are quickly able to accomplish:

  • Securing standard fare tickets on the same train
  • Learn that the first class car has been rented out completely by a half-ogre who has paid for security and privacy, the car is off limits
  • Determine that they need to find a way through both a dinning and a galley car to get to Garra
  • Observe that, if necessary, it would be possible to climb out and on top of the cars

Boarding the train the group attempts to look for Daask sleeper agents but doesn't immediately identify any. Making their way into the dinning car they are seated and start coming up with a plan....or plans? Finally settling on attempting to threaten/convince Garra into giving over the stolen goods. They are able to convince the waitress to deliver a note, a bottle of wine, and a slice of cherry cobbler to Garra. After a lengthy wait, she returns to say that Garra will see them and escorts them to her - ultimately locking them into the car with her.

The conversation goes back and forth between her trying to convince them to either take a bribe to look the other way or join Daask and the group trying to get her to give up. With the group shielding her actions, Cligs is able to cast Sleep on Garra and they get the drop on her. Unbeknownst to them, her invisible Sprite, Rot, has been watching and immediately takes aim at the group. He isn't long for this world as Caelin is able to quickly dispatch him and the group turns their attention back to Garra. In what seems like a completely one-sided battle, a lucky change of pace from their previous encounters, the group is able to quickly and decisively deal with her. They are able to get her chest open and examine it's contents:

  • A collection of books and schemas, the items stolen from the excavation site
  • A feather token
  • 600gp
  • A gem of brightness with 32 charges

Gem of Brightness

Wondrous item, uncommon

This prism has 32 charges. While you are holding it, you can take action and use one of three command words to cause one of the following effects:

  • First Command Word. The gem sheds Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 30 feet. This effect doesn't expend a charge. It lasts until you take a Bonus Action to repeat the command word or until you use another function of the gem.
  • Second Command Word. You expend 1 charge and cause the gem to fire a brilliant beam of light at one creature you can see within 60 feet of yourself. The creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or have the Blinded condition for 1 minute. The creature repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
  • Third Command Word. You expend 5 charges and cause the gem to flare with intense light in a 30-foot Cone. Each creature in the Cone makes a saving throw as if struck by the beam created with the second command word.

When all of the gem's charges are expended, the gem becomes a nonmagical jewel worth 50 GP.

docs.title: Session 20
docs.text:
Having settled on a plan, the party separates. Cligs remains with Grilsha and Lucan; Caelin and Cornelius return to their seats; and S.A.M. and Cassian return to steerage. Back at his seat, Cornelius once again enlists Farnish in the battle against the undead and tells him to be ready. No one from the party decides to attend or eavesdrop on the meeting with Garrow, so Lucan heads to this on his own.

About an hour after they all separate, Cornelius sees Lucan storming back to First Class through the Standard car but doesn't say anything to him. He also sees Garrow follow a few minutes later, clearly frustrated and angry about what happened at the meeting. Back in their cabin, Lucan fills Cligs in on the meeting. He says that Garrow asked him for the Vampire Blade in exchange for safety in Karrnath. Lucan refused to hand it over and refused to work with the Emerald Claw. Cligs asks Cornelius to relay the outcome of the meeting and that Lucan wasn't able to string Garrow along to the others.

docs.title: 20 Eyre
docs.text:
In the morning, Cligs thinks it would be best for Grilsha to leave her room and come stay in the sleeper cabin that S.A.M. had booked. She agrees and on the way out they set an Alarm spell to trigger if anyone other than Grilsha, Lucan, or the party enters the room. Passing by, Cornelius gives Cligs Sending Stones to hand out so that there are 2 paired sets: Cornelius -> Caelin and Cligs -> Cassian. The train sets out for it's next stop, Vathirond, which it should reach around 2pm.

Around Lunch time, Cornelius heads to the dinning car with Farnish. While they are there, Garrow comes, takes a table, and orders a meal. He sees Cornelius and S.A.M. while there and makes a point of smiling and toasting them, though they make sure to give him a wide berth. Shortly after, Cligs' mental Alarm starts going off, alerting her to someone entering Grilsha's cabin. She starts notifying the rest of the group, including using her Sending Stone, telling everyone to get in position because she thinks the Emerald Claw will make their move soon. After some time, Cligs, in the guise of Phillip Crinklebottom, decides to go check out what happened. As she is crossing into the Standard car she notices 3 Hobgoblins drop off the roof of the car and head in and sit down in seats. As she is about to enter, a 4th Hobgoblin drops down - they glance at each other but don't interfere with what they are doing. This Hobgoblin heads the opposite direction. Cligs sends messages letting people know she thinks the Hobgoblins caused the alarm to trigger. Cornelis and S.A.M see the Hobgoblin enter the dining car and sit down with Garrow. They have a brief conversation, which seems to upset Garrow.

The Hobgoblin leaves the dining car. As he passes by Caelin's cabin, which Cassian is still waiting in, Cassian decides to confront him. He accuses the hobgoblin of being Emerald Claw and breaking into the first class cabin. The hobgoblin responds, "Prove it" and starts to walk away. Caelin lunges at the creature and attempts to grapple him. Cligs sees what is happening and tries to diffuse the situation by saying they are making a ruckus, but closes herself and Grilsha into their cabin when it fails to stop the fight. Cornelius and Farnish head back to help out with what is now a real, if lopsided, combat. After a few rounds, a message plays throughout the train, letting passengers know a situation has arrisen and the train will be stopping while House Orien guards searches the train. The party starts to hear whistles from the guards coming. Cassian and Caelin render the Hobgoblin unconscious. Cassian attempts to pull him into the cabin but isn't able to lift him. Cornelius Jumps onto the roof of the car and runs away before the guards get there. When they arrive, they see Farnish in uniform and his explanation that he just arrived and they let him leave. Caelin and Cassian claim that the Hobgoblin shouted something about the Emerald Claw and attacked them. The guards decide to take everyone to the Helm to answer to the Conductor. Caelin steals the Hobgoblin's ID and ticket before the guards take him away.

At the Helm, the Conductor listens to Cassian and Caelin's story and their claims that there are undead in the cargo and ensures them that he is aware of what is happening on the train. He tells them to return to their seats and stop making trouble and he will question the Hobgoblin when he awakens. Caelin is able to discern that the Conductor is aware of what is in the cargo hold but his duty to House Orien is to transport the cargo, as that was what the arrangement was.

docs.title: Next stop, Vathirond
docs.text:
Back at their seats, Farnish no longer seems as eager to follow Cornelius into battle after seeing what happened with the Hobgoblin. The guards search the train after the fight and ultimately the train begins moving again. During the rest of journey to Vathirond, Cligs has Lizzard McGuire search Grilsha's cabin and sees that it has been completely ransacked. The train arrives in Vathirond about an hour behind schedule. Here all of the Brelish soldiers depart - including Farnish. The train only stays briefly and is quickly back on the move, trying to get back on schedule. Just before nightfall, Cligs leaves Grilsha with Lizzard McGuire to go check in with the rest of the group to decide if they are going to continue with the plan. They decide that there isn't really another option and they need to act before Garrow has a chance to launch his next plan of attack. Now that night is falling and they are in Thrane, they decide it's time, Cornelius heads to the back of the train to try and decouple the two cargo cars and the rest of the party heads to collect Grilsha and Lucan to confront Garrow.

As he reaches the back of the steerage car, Cornelius, along with everyone else, can feel that the train is beginning to slow down - but there has not been any announcement as to why. When he gets to the coupling he can see down the car and into cargo that the guards that were posted there seem to now be fighting off the undead. Cornelius quickly acts, using his tinkers tools and knowledge to work at the coupling and is able to sever the connection between the cargo cars and the rest of the train. A few seconds later, disconnected from the magic of the bound elemental, the cargo cards drop to the ground. Cornelius makes to connect with the group, running along the top of the cars to catch up and let them know the undead are loose.

The others start making their way forward, Cassian and Caelin on the roofs of the cars and the S.A.M. and Cligs inside. Once they reach the the end of their sleeper car, they are confronted with two worrisome events: first, a wall of magical Darkness appears to be shrouding the end of the car, completely obscuring the cabin Grilsha is in, and secondly they hear a woman's scream. Caelin and Cassian on the roof are able to see the Darkness but not hear the scream. As they are running they also see a bat fly out of the Darkness and head toward a nearby town. The train comes to a stop, still without any announcement, and the group moves to engage and find out what happened.

Passing into the sphere, Cligs turns Invisible and barely misses getting struck by a dagger in the dark. She feels her way around the cabin and eventually is able to find Grilsha's body, laying on the floor with blood pooling out of a wound in her abdomen. She feels a very faint rise and fall of her chest; she is barely alive. Cligs is able to administer a healing potion to Grilsha to stabilize her and stop the immediate urgency of her wounds. Caelin, Cassian, and S.A.M. move in to try and deal with the threat; Caelin Jason Bournes into the room by swinging over the side of the roof and kicking the window in. As the three of them engage they are eventually able to wound the unseen assailant and cause them to drop their concentration on the Darkness - revealing that the attacker is the mysterious man they have previously seen in Garrow's cabin.

docs.title: Into the Night
docs.text: Eventually, they are able to defeat Winn, Grilsha's would-be assassin. S.A.M. convinces the group that, even though Garrow is a threat, recovering Lucan and the Vampire Blade is their mission and must be their priority. Cligs convinces Grilsha to come with them to save her brother. Cassian, S.A.M., Cornelius, Cligs, and Grilsha begin to head off the train to pursue Lucan towards the town. Caelin decides to stay and go after Garrow and separate from the party, for now.

docs.title: Clang, clang, clang
docs.text:
Caelin heads to the front of the train to pursue Garrow while the rest of the party, plus Grilsha, step off the train into what would be a pleasant Spring evening, were it not for the situation at hand. Directly ahead of them they can hear a loud rhythmic clanging noise. Quickly surveying the town they find a ruined sign that proclaims this to be the town of Caravan Crossing, which seems to have been a crossing of House Orien's caravan routes and the lightning rail, important for moving cargo. At some point in the recent past this outpost was destroyed and what remains is mostly the broken remnants of the stone structures of the town: the House Orien warehouse and the towns inn, both in states of collapse but semi-intact. In the distance they can also see a tower in the surrounding forest, it seems mostly whole.

Discussing the options, they decide that Lucan would seek out somewhere enclosed, possibly with a basement, for protection from the daylight. They initially think that they will head for the tower and then work their way back this way if they can't find Lucan. As they are discussing the clanging, which was coming from the warehouse, stops and the group can see a skeletal minotaur charging at them. Though physically imposing, the creature is dumb and the party is able to eliminate him without any major issue. The group takes a quick look inside and finds that most of the roof has collapsed and there isn't a whole lot to see. Cornelius volunteers to search the warehouse for anything of importance, the rest of the group heads towards the tower. They quickly scan the ruined inn from the outside and don't see or hear anything that seems of importance and S.A.M. Locate Object isn't picking up Lucan's signet ring.

docs.title: To the Tower
docs.text:
As they are moving through the woods, Cligs is sending off illusory Lucan's to try and distract anything that might be out in the woods. As they get close to the clearing where the tower is two things happen: first, they hear a loud explosion coming from the tower - but don't see any immediate damage. Second, Cligs noticed that one of her illusions has drawn the attention of something in the woods, that is going after it - she does not share this with the rest of the group.

The explosion prompted S.A.M. to rush toward the tower. As he clears the woods, he takes in the sight of what appears to be a small camp outside the tower as well as a pair of skeletal gnolls that seems to be guarding the tower - these immediately get ready to attack when they see the group emerge. Grilsha calls down a Fireball on the gnolls, which sends flames up the sides of the tower and damages them. S.A.M. follows this up by Shattering the gnolls as well, which has the unintended but helpful consequence of blasting the door off of it's hinges and into the tower. When the door comes off the group can see inside the tower entryway, which seems to have a small troop of Emerald Claw soldiers attempting to enter a room - several of them are damaged by the door as it flies into the room. It takes some work, but the group is able to eliminate the soldiers and the gnolls.

They decide to see what was going on with the door the soldiers were trying to get into, assuming that maybe Lucan had barricaded the door. They are surprised to see that the door is barricaded from the outside and that perhaps the soldiers were debating if they should open this door. Cligs uses her Mage Hand to open the door and finds the room beyond is completely obscured without any light. She tosses Lizzard McGuire into the room and in the second before she is obliterated Cligs is able to see, thanks to Darkvision, that there is another door beyond but, more importantly, there are several Gricks being kept in this room. She closes and re-locks the door. Examining the main room, this appears to be the source of the explosion they heard, the walls are singed and there are small fires around the room. Cligs can identify the remains of several Glyphs of Warding carved into the stone floor.

There is another door on this floor, attempting to open it the door seems sealed closed. S.A.M. uses Knock and the door pops open, he enters the room and sees it has several occupants. There are several tables that have jars and containers as well as two with subjects on them, one a dead gnoll similar to the ones that were outside, and another that seems to have a grick with several of it's tentacles chopped off. There is also a seemingly twisted version of the same gnoll standing in the corner holding a scimitar, with what appears to be some fort of elongated neck. There also is a halfling woman standing in the room, apparently working on the two corpses. S.A.M. attempts to talk to her, trying to get her to give up without a fight. She seems to think on this for a moment....and then points a finger at him and fires a Ray of Sickness at him. Her creature joins the fight. She gets in several good shots, including a Shatter on Cligs and Grilsha, but the group is eventually able to defeat her and her her gnoll and prevent her from raising the other creatures. In here, S.A.M uncovers several papers of relevance including detailed notes of Destara's experiments, several letters that appear to relate to House Jorasco (that he conceals from the group) and a letter signed "Brother G" that appears to detail their ambush her. She was dispatched here with another Emerald Claw agent, named Nikovech, a contingent of soldiers and a number of undead to ambush "the target" when he fled here. It also details that she has a Familiar out in the woods that she is using to communicate with Garrow.

In this room they also find a ceramic jar sealed with wax and contains 200 gp worth of diamond powder, a similar ceramic jar is unsealed and contains 50 gp worth of gold powder, a scroll of animate dead and a spell book containing the following spells: detect magic, unseen servant, and gentle repose.

They ascend the spiral staircase up to the next level, which the main room appears to have been converted into a barracks for the guards they killed below. A second room on this floor looks like it might be the grim bedroom of a twisted mind - a dead bear with part of it's face missing seems to be magically suspended in it's current state and being used as a bed. They find a small chest at the foot of the bed that seems to again be magically sealed. S.A.M. doesn't want to spend another spell slot on it, so Cassian takes the chest and throws it down the stairs where it shatters on the floor and Cligs collects its contents: 80 gp, 100 sp, and Destara's spell book containing 1st level: Find familiar, jump, mage armor, protection from evil and good, ray of sickness, sleep, shield; 2nd level: darkvision, invisibility, knock, misty step, shatter, web; 3rd level: animate dead, counterspell, fear, sending

They attempt to ascend the to the next level but find the top of the stairs are blocked by some type of wooden furniture. They try to push it out of the way but neither S.A.M. nor Cassian are strong enough to...so S.A.M. throws an Alchemist Fire at it and they descend the stairs to let it burn. Returning to the top of the stairs a few minutes later they find that the furniture has burned away but they are faced with a horde of Zombies waiting there...several of which have caught on fire. Cassian holds them at bay while S.A.M. uses his wand of web to spread the flames to all of the zombies. Cligs encourages the two men to let the zombies burn to death. Eventually they agree and keep the flames going and preventing the zombies from leaving and eventually are able to defeat them all. They head into the only door on this floor that they can see. It appears that someone had been in here not that long ago, there are some personal belonging that were left in a hurry. S.A.M. sees another door at the back of the room and goes to investigate. It's locked and when S.A.M. puts his hear to the door and he hears "Uuuurgh. Mmmgh." Deciding that there are more undead on the other side, they decide to go back down to Grilsha, who has been working on casting Scrying while the rest have been exploring the tower.

docs.title: A Final Showdown
docs.text:
When they return to Grilsha she has finished casting the spell and begins communicating with her brother. They can only hear her side of the conversation but she is filling him in on what they have found in the tower, that they are here to help, and that they won't hurt him. It takes some convincing but but he eventually shows them where he is, having traveled through the darkened room with the Gricks and into the room beyond and down a trapdoor into the basement. They decide that the best course of action is to distract the grick with a food source and use bright light to shock them as they quickly traverse the room. To avoid having to toss a whole body into the room, they start hacking off limbs from the dead soldiers to use as bait. Cligs opens the door once again with her mage hand and the others toss their offerings into the room. S.A.M. fires up the Gem of Brightness and they rush through the room and into the second one. They quickly find the trapdoor and descend into the basement.

They work on convincing Lucan to hand over the blade and come with them to safety. It takes some time but finally Lucan produces the blade and hands it to Cassian, seemingly struggling to do so. As soon as it is in his hands the blade begins whispering to Cassian, urging him to kill the vampire and that they can do great things. With great effort, he resists the pull of the blade and puts it into Clig's bag of holding. Once it is in the extradimensional space a sort of peace falls over Lucan's face. He thanks the group for their help and offer but thinks the best thing is for him and Grilsha to travel alone from here. He shows the group a passage he found that leads to the town and they travel it together. When they emerge on the other end it enters into the basement below the warehouse. The group say their goodbyes to the Stellos' and head back up to Cornelius, who ended up getting lost in reading a book.

They return to the train and find most of the passengers hanging around outside. They find Caelin there as well, who tells them that they got to the Helm in search of Garrow but he was gone. Instead, he found that the conductor's head was exploded by Garrow after he got the man to stop the train. Caelin went with Jaralie to deal with the undead in the cargo. S.A.M. informs her of the infestation at the tower and she assures him that the Silver Flame will dispatch soldiers to deal with it. Several hours after they first stopped a continent of House Orien guards and a replacement conductor arrive via Teleportation Circle and get the train moving again. The party transfers at the next station to a train bound for Sharn and they make their way back home.

docs.title: Just Rewards
docs.text: Several days later the party return to Sharn and they arrange a meeting with Elaydren. When they meet with her she seems happy to see them but she seems exhausted. They do not question her about this at the time. She asks for a debrief on their adventure and if they have the blade. Cligs transfers the vampire blade into Elaydren's own bag of holding and the party fills her in on all that they have learned. She rewards them for completing the mission and information accordingly: - For preventing Garrow from getting the blade and returning it to her, she gives them each 600 gp - Revealing that Garrow is not actually a vampire she gives them 250 gp - Identifying Nikovech and Destarashe rewards them 400 gp, and - Identifying Neya ir'Krell and Meena ir'Edalis as members of the Royal Eyes of Aundair she rewards them 250 gp - She also allows them each to choose a potion of climbing, a potion of growth, a potion of resistance (fire), or a potion of water breathing.

docs.title: Downtime
docs.text:
Having returned from Thrane and me with Elaydren for their rewards the party has some downtime to pursue other interests. Here is what everyone got up to:

  • Caelin: Purchased a new set of magic armor (+1 studded) and offloaded some unwanted items at the Bazaar.
  • Cassian: He had a long awaited reunion with the Forgotten Prince, who officially became his Patron and bestowed upon him more power drawn from Thelanis and a powerful tool (+1 Rod of the Pact Keeper). He also shared that one of the most precious things that has been lost and he has been searching for is his true name.
  • Cligs: Lost her job because she kept disappearing on adventures. Decided to shake down Elaydren for money since she got fired. Elaydren agrees to give her 15gp per month to cover her lost wages.
  • Cornelius: Took Evine d'Sivis on several dates - but they are taking things slow. He also began working on a set of plate armor.
  • S.A.M.: Received an invitation for a private dinner with Elaydren, which he accepted and filled her in on more of the details of their last adventure and things he didn't tell the rest of the party. Elaydren rewarded his loyalty by gifting him with a Docent, a small metal sphere that he embedded in his chest. The Docent is sentient and goes by Phineas and can help S.A.M. with certain tasks.

docs.title: 16 Dravago
docs.text: The group meets for their weekly dinner to catch up and check-in to see if they have more work. While they are meeting, a gargoyle messenger arrives at the tavern with a message from Elaydren inviting them to meet with her later that evening for a new job.

docs.title: Ding, dong, undead
docs.text:
Arriving to Elaydren's town house things appear wrong, the door is open, papers are scattered, and several windows are smashed. A shadow passes across the door and they hear a shout from a woman come from inside. Rushing in to the scene, Cassian sees three undead soldiers have Elaydren cornered - several corpses of her household staff and guards are strewn about the ground floor and there is one dead zombie.

Seeing the party, Elaydren begins to retreat back to further and gratefully accepts their help. More difficult than other undead they have faced, these three put up quite the fight - shouting slogans that sound like Karrnathi military slogans. Eventually they are able to overcome them and end the battle.

Elaydren fills the group in on what happened. A jolly merchant talked his way inside the door, only to melt into the Blood of Vol priest, Brother Garrow and in came his Emerald Claw soldiers and the 4 Karrnathi zombies. They killed her staff and stole her schemas, the creation pattern, and some recently uncovered notes from Elaydren's ancestor, Kedran d'Cannith, that indicate where the final piece of the pattern is. She asks them to go after the Emerald Claw and get to the schema before they can and return the others to her.

When they accept, Elaydren offers them 5,000gp each for the successful return of all of the schemas, the notes, and the creation pattern. She tells them she will arrange transport to Stormreach, the coastal city on the continent of Xen'drik where the final schema is located. She gives them a letter of credit for 5,000 gp to cover prep costs and tells them to return in 2 hours. They head to the Bazaar and purchase a number of items that they think will be useful for the upcoming journey, mainly healing potions.

docs.title: Under the Sea
docs.text:
Returning to Elaydren, she informs them that she has arranged transport on a secret creation of House Cannith, an undersea ship that can travel under the water and get them there discreetly - and hopefully ahead of the Emerald Claw. She gives them directions to the Stone Docks, Grayflood district and to the ships captain, Byam. She tells them to hunt the Emerald Claw if they can, but if they cant then to head towards the ruins 400 miles inland from Stormreach, up the Rachi River. She gives them the clue from Kedran's journal: At the turn in the Rachi River, where the land rises and the hands of stone reach for the sky, look toward the giant’s left hand for guidance to the schema’s resting place. Finally, she gives each person a small pouch with 2,500gp worth of gems.

They make their way to meet with Byam, who escorts them to a warehouse set back from the docks. There he shows them the Sea Dart, Cannith's underwater ship powered by water elemental. Unlike most other vessels, this one is completely sealed from the outside and the only entrance appears to be a hatch at the top. There are several gnome crew loading the vessel up, who don't seem to happy to be sharing the ship with so many large passengers.

The captain gives them a brief tour of the ship and , once settled in, the hatch pressurizes and the ship descends into the water and takes off under the Thunder Sea toward Xen'drik. The captain does warn the party that in order to follow Elaydren's instructions to get them there as fast as possible he will be taking a route through Shargon's Teeth, territory under the control of sahuagin raiders. Going around their territory would add more than 1 and a half days to the journey. S.A.M. says the group will be ready if needed.

docs.title: 17 Dravago
docs.text:
Their first day of travel takes them beneath the Thunder Sea, where traveling under the waves allows them to avoid most of the dangers of pirates on the surface. Their travel day is mostly uneventful. S.A.M. plays some traditional Zil music and is able to, if not make the gnomes like him at least put them at ease with his presence. Cligs takes this opportunity to study how Byam works the ship, noticing that he does not have a Mark of Storm which is normally how elemental ships are controlled. Cligs notices that Byam speaks to the ship in Primordial as part of the control mechanism. At one point, she thinks she has understood and when the captain steps away she tries to make an adjustment to the ship - and succeeds! Byam sends her off the bridge at that point.

Cornelius uses his time to study designs for the plate mail that he is working on back in Sharn. Cassian seems uneasy and occupies himself doing pushups and twirling his big black crystal rod. Caelin was put on guard by the captain saying they couldn't use the second berth across the hall and decides to check it out. They do so and....it is empty. They decide to steal a pillow and ultimately to sneak in and sleep in there.

docs.title: 18 Dravago
docs.text: "Morning," such as it is under the waves, arrives and the party finds the crew about the business of keeping the Sea Dart running. S.A.M. once again takes up playing for the crew as they get their morning meal and is able to make a few more of them friendly towards the group. Caelin decides to proselytize to the gnomes and converts Zander, Tallian, and Talia to the word of Aureon and the Sovereign Host. Cassian takes a rest day, having spent much of the previous day working out. Cornelius spends most of the morning reading up and preparing to continue to work on his armor when he returns to Sharn. Cligs tries to get back on to the bridge, only to find that the captain has given orders that she not be allowed on the bridge any more. She casts Invisibility on Lizzard McGuire and manages to sneak her onto the bridge and has her spy.

docs.title: Da-dum, da-dum, da-dum
docs.text:
Around noon, the captain calls the party to the observation blister. There he shows them an underwater view of Shargon's Teeth - massive stone columns that shoot up to the surface and between them are fields of phosphorescent kelp and bright fish of all sizes darting about. As they are watching S.A.M. is the only one who manages to notice the massive shark bearing down on them and is able to brace before the shark smashes into the ship. The crew and the rest of the party are knocked off balance by the impact. Shouts from the crew start to rise up about damage to the elemental binding and the ship taking on water. The captain orders the ship to the surface for repairs.

As they rise to the surface the ship gets caught on something, presumably the kelp has gotten caught up. Four of the crew plus S.A.M., Cligs, Cassian, and Caelin exit the ship in order to work on freeing the ship. Cornelius remains inside to help with repairs. They find that what the ship is actually caught up in appears to be a massive net stretched between several of the stone columns and trapping the ship in four points - they begin to work on freeing the ship.

While they are working on this, S.A.M. and Cligs get a quick glimpse of a humanoid with a tail swimming off away from the scene. Struggling with the rope nets eventually out of the darkness the shark returns and attempts to gobble up one of the crew. It continues to harass them while they work. They eventually are able to drive it off and free the ship. The crew returns inside but the party remains outside for the ascent to the surface.

docs.title: Parley
docs.text:
Breaching the surface, the crew secure the ship to a nearby relatively flat top of a column and get to work on repairs. S.A.M. posts up in the ship scanning the water below with two Everbright Lanterns to keep watch. Cligs summons a new Familiar, Eelijah Wood, to swim through the waters and help keep watch. Caelin communes with the kelp forests and asks them to give them a sign if anything bigger than a fish approaches the ship. Cassian chills. Cornelius aids in repairs.

S.A.M. catches sight of the shark that seems to be keeping it's distance just at the edge of the Lantern light (120 feet). Caelin notices that the kelp forest glow has started pulsing in the rough direction of where the shark was reported by S.A.M. Cligs sees creatures rising through the water and alerts the captain, who identifies them as Sahuagin warriors. He offers to try to parley on behalf of the party, since he speaks their language, but tells them to quickly figure out what they are willing to offer as tribute.

Byam and the lead Sahuagin have a brief conversation and then Byam asks for what the party is offering. They decide to offer Cligs' Wand of Firebolt, an Everbright Lantern from the part stash, and S.A.M. offers a Potion of Growth. The captain explains these items to the Sahuagin and is able to negotiate for safe passage through the rest of the Teeth.

docs.title: 19-20 Dravago
docs.text: With safe passage having been been negotiated by Byam, the rest of their journey to Stormreach is uneventful. S.A.M. and Cligs have a heart-to-heart about her desire to learn how elemental ships work and to be able to pilot one. S.A.M. offers to write a letter to Elaydren on Cligs' behalf about this and try to help her achieve this goal.

docs.title: Stormreach
docs.text:
Late on the second day following the attack of the magebred shark, the captain brings the Sea Dart to the surface just outside of Stormreach. The city stands out as a lone beacon of civilization along a coast completely dominated by jungles. He docks the ship and hides it among the jungle flora about a mile down the coast, giving the party instructions to enter the city through the docks. He gives them travel papers that indicate they arrived on the House Lyrandar galleon Strong Wind as part of an expedition from Morgrave University. He also gives them a letter of credit but instructs them that it can only be used at the House Cannith enclave and only to arrange transportation into the jungle. With that, they set out for the city and discuss their plans, deciding to split up when they reach the city to try and do some recon before nightfall.

They arrive in the city and split up: - Cassian and S.A.M. converse with dock workers and sailors in the Harbor district and eventually make their way to the Wavecrest Tavern to arrange rooms for the night and try and get a lead on transport downriver. - Cornelius heads out to the Cannith Enclave to inquire there about using the letter of credit for transport. - Caelin and Cligs start out together going to the Market, looking for maps and other information about the area. They eventually also split up, with Cligs heading toward Falconer's Spire, the House Lyrandar airship docking tower, to inquire about recent arrivals and Caelin heading to the Blood of Vol temple.

Their exploits turn up some results: - Cassian "Man of the People" ir'Bellona manages to gather some intel about possible places they can ask about riverboat travel. - S.A.M.'s generous tips and subtle threats secure them a set of rooms at the Tavern and the Hobgoblin barkeep agreed to provide them with a contact in the morning who can discreetly take them downriver. - Cligs learns, after learning herself that being cheap doesn't open people's lips, that an airship recently docked from Sharn that had a number of armored warriors, a heavily armed warforged, and a strange undead creature being kept below decks. They appeared to have been led by a Half-Elf named Rarwog. They airship then headed off to follow the Rachi River. - Caelin spies on the Blood of Vol temple and identifies the head priestess. They approach and out loud ask about the faith but put a message in the priestess' head about Brother Garrow and the Emerald Claw. She quickly escorts them into her office. There she tells them that Brother Garrow, a terrifying vampire, and a monstrous undead creature came to visit her and ask about the jungle and the ruins it contains. She had directed them to Provost Baris Kaven, leader of the Morgrave Expedition who is the most knowledgable about the ruins around Stormreach.

docs.title: 20 Dravago
docs.text:
Cligs and Caelin meet up outside of the Blood of Vol temple and start heading back to the Tavern, sharing what they have learned on the way. They also stop in at Curra's Curiosities, a Drow-owned shop with a collection of wares that also advertises selling maps. Curra shows them the maps she has of the area south of the city and encourages them to purchase a Drow-made map in order to not fall victim to the Traveler's Curse. They end up paying for a Drow map which shows about 700 miles of the Rachi River that appears to have been a hunter's map, showing various dangers and hunting locations. It also shows the location of a giant ruin, indicated by a hand sticking up out of the ground.

Traveler's Curse

The Traveler’s Curse is one of Xen’drik’s most famous anomalies. Explorers may find their journey accelerated to a fraction of the time needed, or slowed down by months, but perceive the journey as completely normal. Two groups traveling the same path can arrive at the same destination at different times - or even different destinations altogether. The Curse is unpredictable.

Back at the Wavecrest, Cassian tries to have a conversation with S.A.M. about the source of his power and his fears around that. S.A.M. encourages him to trust his judgement and that so far it seems that the added power has been only beneficial. S.A.M. then discusses with Cassian about the need to prioritize the mission, returning the schemas and other items to Elaydren, over the party and their plans. Cassian seems to agree.

After they leave Curra's Caelin talks to Cligs about the fact that they are worried they are losing their way and straying from Aureon's teachings. Cligs tries to reassure them. The two then move on to plotting how they may deal with S.A.M. and Elaydren when it comes to returning the schemas, creation pattern, and documents.

Returning to the Tavern, Cligs checks in with the Hobgoblin barkeep (who is named Marbur, even though no one asked) about their rooms. Cligs, Caelin and Marbur have a brief conversation in Goblin before the two party members head upstairs. Reuniting with the others, they share their information - it is then that they realize that Cornelius hasn't returned from the Cannith enclave. The group decide that they probably need a name....but also to split up again, with Cassian and Caelin heading to talk to the Provost at the Morgrave Expedition and Cligs and S.A.M. heading to the Cannith enclave to find Cornelius.

docs.title: Morgrave, more like Sadgrave
docs.text:
Caelin attempts to disguise Cassian again, this time as an experienced researcher and writer but instead gives him a cool looking gray streak in his hair. They head to the boarding house and find the students, but it seems like the Provost is out for the evening. The two try to endear themselves to the students but it doesn't go so well. Eventually, they are able to learn that the Provost tends to drink at the Lusty Mermaid a few blocks away. They head over and talk to the barkeep, slipping her some coin to point out the Provost and what his drink of choice is. She points to a sad looking man sitting alone in the corner drinking a Mermaid Juice, the house drink. The two go over and use the cover of wanting to write about giant ruins and Caelin being an illustrator to get information from him.

He confirms that Garrow and a warforged named Scimitar came to visit him and he provided them some information. He relays the same information that the safest way to travel is to follow the River and avoid cutting through the jungle as it is far too dangerous. He also gave them some rough ideas of the ruins along the river and what they might find. Finally, he suggests that Chinxero, a grizzled riverboat captain, would be their best bet to get them there quickly as he is in possession of the only elemental-powered riverboat in Stormreach.

docs.title: Cannith Cassanova
docs.text:
S.A.M. and Cligs make their way to the Citadel of the Twelve, where House Cannith has a series of offices as opposed to their own standalone enclave here. Arriving their they make their way to their space in the basement, the interior has been converted into a large workroom with a variety of different equipment setups. There is someone who seems to be in charge sitting at the front desk who appears to have very similar features to Elaydren. They also see Cornelius in the back, seemingly helping a Cannith artisan at the forge. They check-in with the woman at the desk and then go to talk to Cornelius. He is working with a young, attractive, blacksmith named Leila. S.A.M. covertly relays to Cornelius that they are staying at the Wavecrest and that they have picked up some information and that Cornelius should come there when done. He also passes off the letter of credit to S.A.M. who quickly examines it and notices that the handwriting is Elaydren's and it seems to be written in a very personal way directed to the woman at the front desk.

They talk to her on their way out, her name is Channa Vown d'Cannith and S.A.M. relays to her what they are looking for - transportation down the Rachi River, and gives her the letter. She takes a quick glance and they can see she clearly recognizes the writing. S.A.M. asks her to stop by the Tavern the next day.

docs.title: Obviously a Trap
docs.text:
The four meet up again, Cornelius still occupied with Leila, and head back to the Wavecrest. As they approach they find that there is a small girl standing outside seemingly waiting for someone, clutching a note in her hand. When she sees them she goes running up and practically begs them to the take the note and let her go home. The note appears to be scrawled in blood and says "I answer asks for gold. I Surthain. Meet now, Xaponath Lane, Old Quarter.” The girl, Samna, confirms that she was given the note on Xaponath Lane, but that it is in Southwatch, there is no Old Quarter in the town.

S.A.M. is, unsurprisingly hesitant to get involved, but Cligs and Caelin are adamant that they help the girl and Cassian is able to be swayed, they all head out. Arriving at the place indicated, it appears to be a dead-ended alley mostly obscured by building and few lights. The party investigates and finds a lone figure standing at the end with a cloak pulled up over their head. S.A.M. tries to talk to the figure but it is intent on violence. It attacks and when it has drawn several of the party into the alley it's allies, a pair of ghouls, move in to try and trap the party. During the fighting a mysterious Elven woman joins the battle and it is to help the party.

docs.title: Prophesy-schmophesy
docs.text: After helping to eliminate the undead, the Elf reveals her name is Muroni and that the group was spoken about in the Draconic Prophesy and that she was sent here by Vuulaytherus, a silver dragon who studies the prophesy and found the verses that speak about the party. She tells them that is predicted that a a group of adventures tied to House Cannith would arrive to Xen'Drik from under the sea and she saw them arrive on the Sea Dart. She asks to accompany them on the journey to observe and that she can also help them along the way. S.A.M. doesn't really buy into the Prophesy thing but both him and Cassian are mostly concerned that she might pull them off their mission in service of the prophesy - she assures them that she is just here to help. Finally, the group agree to bring her in and they all return to the Wavecrest Tavern.

docs.title: 20 Dravago
docs.text: The group wraps up the day by spending time talking to Muroni in the tavern, asking her questions about the prophesy and Vuulaytherus. She doesn't have much more to add about the prophesy but tells them about growing up amongst the dragons of Argonnessen.

docs.title: 21 Dravago
docs.text:
In the morning, the group meets in the common room to eat and discuss their plans. S.A.M. chats with Marbur, the hobgoblin barkeep, who provides him with the names of 4 potential riverboat captains that will take varying amounts of time and have different sized crews and vessels. Ultimately, S.A.M. advises the group to go with Chinxero since they can get an in through Channa and it is the fastest option.

On cue, Channa arrives to the tavern with the letter from Elaydren and refers to the group as "Elaydren's Angels," clearly in a belittling tone, who has evidently filled in her cousin on how helpful the group has been to her. She tries to imply that she knows more than she does and to get the group to speak more openly, but they don't give her much. She agrees to cash in her favor with Chinxero to help the group on the condition that they check-in with her on their return journey.

docs.title: Definitely a bastard
docs.text: S.A.M., Cornelius, and Cassian head out to secure Chinxero's services for the journey south. He is, as has been promised, a difficult person to deal with. He doesn't want to commit to so much time and so long of a journey, even with the Cannith favor being called in. Ultimately, the trio is able to negotiate a deal to get him to agree to the trip in exchange for 2,000gp. He tells them that The Marlow will be ready to depart in 3 hours.

docs.title: Getting underway
docs.text:
Back at the tavern, Muroni arrives and is greeted by Caelin and Cligs. They fill her in on where the others are and she offers to contribute to the cost of the travel expense. She gives the duo 200gp, which they pocket. When the others return S.A.M. informs them that the cost was much higher and Muroni offers to add more gold, but the Bard tells her it's all covered and not to worry. With that, they all make their way to the river dock to head out on the Rachi River.

Most of that first day of travel is spent leaving Stormreach and the small communities surrounding it. After a few hours they are in the proper thick of the jungle but still a ways from the more dangerous part of the deeper jungle. During their travels Cligs again tries to learn what she can about controlling elemental bindings without a dragonmark; Caelin converts 2 crew mates to the glory of Aureon (Raoul and Sidney); S.A.M. begins teaching Cassian the fiddle; and Cornelius takes up fishing, providing the ship with several fresh caught rainbow trout for their evening meal.

docs.title: Close encounter of the undead kind
docs.text: After their shared meal of grilled fish, hardtack for Caelin, and conversation most of the ship heads to bed. S.A.M., Snailor Swift, and Raoul are all on night watch. A couple hours into the evening S.A.M. notices a pair of lights that seem to be enticing Raoul and eventually it appears they are hurting him - S.A.M. raises the alarm and the party comes to help. A second pair of lights, which are identified by Caelin and Cligs as Will-o'-Wisps, are approaching from the east as well. They manage to save Raoul from having his life drained and kill 2 of the Wisps, the others are able to escape.

docs.title: 22 Dravago
docs.text: The Marlow sets out again at first light and the party occupies their time during the day. Cligs again spends time with Chinxero, Quire (the first mate), and just generally watching how the ship works. Caelin makes three more converts: Bernard, Chud, and Brandy. S.A.M. and Cassian continue to practice and Cassian is able to play his first tune. Cornelius continues fishing and bringing in fresh food for the ship.

docs.title: Sorry to interrupt
docs.text:
After lunch time, the boat comes upon an interesting scene. An ettin is standing in the water, close to the banks of the river and seems to be talking to an ogre that it sitting on the shore. They are far enough away and not paying enough attention to notice the boat right away. Phineas gives S.A.M. a heads up that they appear to be speaking Giant and it seems that the ettin is hitting on the ogre, trying to impress him. Phineas encourages S.A.M. that the situation can probably be dealt with without violence.

Cligs also notices what is happening, but not speaking Giant is concerned. She makes an illusion of an "pretty ogre lady head" splashing in the water. This gets the attention of the ettin but not in a good way. Cligs then centers a Sleep spell on the duo which seems to take effect - hoping that they remain asleep long enough for the boat to pass by. Unfortunately, it appears the ettin is immune to this effect and seeing it's friend passed out and the flopping ogre head, starts to move in on the boat. Cassian uses Phantasmal Force to make the ettin believe that the sun is falling down on it, the ettin dives under water and begins to swim away. The Marlow is able to continue on without facing further incident and Chinxero is appreciative of their help, but is wondering if they might be a magnet for trouble.

docs.title: 22 Dravago
docs.text:
Following their encounter with the ettin, the crew continue upriver until sunset and Chinxero calls a halt for the day, making camp anchored in the river. After settling in for the night, Cligs begins having conversations with the rest of the group about Muroni. She first talks to S.A.M. who is on board with either having her removed from the boat or just outright killing her if necessary. She then speaks with Cassian and Cornelius about not trusting the elf, they seem less convinced that she is a threat to their mission but are also fine with leaving her behind if it becomes necessary. Cornelius is interested in the two books she seems to have with her. They tell her she needs to speak to Caelin, who seems to be getting close to Muroni.

While this is happening, Caelin continues their work of converting the crew to the good word of Aureon. Through their ministering they are able to convert three more of the crew, Jefford, Kirkwell, and Bulah. Finally, Cligs reaches out to Caelin to discuss their concerns about Muroni. Unsurprisingly, Caelin is not quite as on board with abandoning Muroni along the river believing that through their conversations with the elf she is being honest about her intentions and information.

In a, perhaps misguided, effort to calm the situation, Caelin casts charm person on Cligs but the spell fails. Cligs is enraged by this mental intrusion and responds by casting phantasmal force on Caelin, making them believe that a swarm of bees is attacking them. Caelin runs out of the room and jumps into the water, at which point Cligs drops the spell and yells at Caelin.

Muroni reaches over the side of the boat to help pull Caelin back onboard. When she asks what is happening, Caelin is honest about the conversation and Cligs concern and potential plan to leave her behind. Muroni is confused and hands Caelin the books to review, unfortunately they are written in Draconic script which Caelin doesn't read. Caelin then escorts Muroni to talk to Cligs.

Muroni does her best to reassure Cligs, offering her the books she has as well to read but Cligs also doesn't read Draconic. Muroni tries to walk her through the sections of the Draconic Prophesy that led her to the group and reaffirms that her goal is to observe what happens around the group and to help them as needed, she has no intention of betraying the group or helping the Emerald Claw. For now, Cligs seems content.

To round out the evening, Caelin tells Chinxero that Cligs may try to steal the boat.

docs.title: Daytime
docs.text:
The following morning, the crew pulls anchor and they set back to traveling up the river. During the day there are no major incidents, but they each get involved in various activities. Cornelius is back to fishing and manages to reel in 3 eels, prized for their taste and quality in cooked dishes. Cligs tries to spend most of the day observing Chinxero but he seems less inclined to let the goblin observe him, but doesn't send her away. S.A.M. and Cassian work on practicing their music. S.A.M. also notices that the drums they heard on the first day still seem to be happening.

Caelin attempts to convert both Wyck, the final crew member, and Quire, the first mate, but fails with both. They notice that Wyck appears to bear a tattoo of The Traveler, one of the Dark Six. After failing with Quire, the first mate tells them about Vulkoor, the drow scorpion god who he worships. After listening to Quire, Caelin notices a number of similarities to The Mockery, another of the Dark Six.

docs.title: Evening
docs.text:
After traveling the whole day, the Marlow makes camp again for the evening when the sun sets. Cornelius cooks up the eels that he caught earlier in the day for the crew and the rest of the party. After dinner, the crew retires below deck for the night except for two who remain on watch, Wyck and Bulah. S.A.M. remains on the deck but not on watch, and Caelin also takes up a watch.

When everyone is asleep, Caelin believes that they hear a noise coming from the western banks of the river. S.A.M. ignites on of the Everbright Lanterns and sweeps it over the area that Caelin pointed out. As he does so, he sees a large six-legged cat jumping out of the jungle towards the boat. A second cat also emerges from the jungle. Caelin uses Sanctuary to protect Bulah and sends her to go wake the rest of the party and get to safety below deck. The rest of the group, and Muroni, awaken and emerge to help with the situation and the apparent leader of this pack, a Displacer Beast, also emerges from the jungle to join the fray.

Eventually, the party is able to overcome and defeat the cats. Sensing their defeat, they do try to flee but the party is adamant about eliminating the threat and all three cats are killed. Caelin attempts to skin the Displacer Beast and botches it, ruining the hide. Cornelius does the same with the jungle cats and is able to harvest two mediocre hides and a significant amount of tiger meat.

docs.title: Daytime
docs.text:
Once again, in the morning the crew pulls anchor and they continue on the journey. Cligs again notices the captain being distant and asks him about what is going on. Chinxero tells Cligs about what Caelin said but she is able to ensure him that she is not trying to steal his boat, only learn how such vessels work.

Cornelius fishes again and manages to pull out of the river a silver brooch inlaid with a wave pattern. He then sells this to Cassian for the former to use in a ritual later that day.

S.A.M., Cligs, and Quire talk about the proximity of the drums coming from the west. Quire tells them about how most drow tribes uses drums as signals for hunting and war parties and to communicate in and across the jungle.

Caelin notices a large mass of what appears to be jungle detritus float past the boat and then seem to get stuck to the back of the vessel. Caelin, Cassian, and Cornelius go investigate the situation. Carefully investigating the mass they are able to determine that it isn't what it appears and is in fact a shambling mound. After a few failed attempts they are able to dislodge it but it continues to follow them. Cligs steps in an uses Phantasmal Force to make it believe that a hippopotamus is coming to eat it and it flees.

docs.title: Evening
docs.text:
After making camp, Cornelius grills up some tiger steaks for everyone while Cassian regales the crew with stories about Thelanis and the Forgotten Prince, all the while performing the ritual he was taught by his patron on the brooch that Cornelius recovered. At the conclusion of his story, ice swirls about the brooch and then it vanishes, along with a message for the Prince.

Caelin, with the help of one of his converts, has a conversation with the captain about the glory and grace of Aureon and, finally, is able to convert the captain as well.

Quire seeks out S.A.M. to let him know that he had been listening to the drums and consulting his notes and is able to confirm that the drums are war drums. He also tells them that he believes they have entered the territory of the chief Amoxtli and shows them the drow script that might be placed to denote an area as under Amoxtli's domain.
